descriptions.title: Data Scientist I - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
descriptions.description:
Who You'll Work With
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
Your Impact
As a Data Scientist I, you will collaborate with clients and interdisciplinary teams to develop impactful analytics solutions, optimize code, and solve real-world business problems across diverse industries. You’ll grow as a technologist by contributing to cutting-edge projects, R&D, and global conferences while working alongside world-class talent in a dynamic, innovative environment.
In this role, you will partner with clients to understand their needs and develop impactful analytics solutions. You will translate business problems into analytical challenges, build models to solve them, and ensure they are evaluated with relevant metrics. You’ll also contribute to internal tools, participate in R&D projects, and have opportunities to attend and present at conferences like NIPS and ICML.
Your work will create real-world impact. By identifying patterns in data and delivering innovative solutions, you will help clients maintain their competitive advantage and transform their day-to-day operations. Your contributions will directly influence business outcomes and drive lasting improvements across industries.
You will be based in either one of our McKinsey Digital Africa offices - Johanessburg or Casablanca, and collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, designers, and product managers around the world working on interdisciplinary projects that use math, statistics, and machine learning to derive insights from raw data. You will help global companies transform their businesses and enhance performance across industries such as healthcare, automotive, energy, and elite sports.
At McKinsey, you’ll thrive in an unparalleled environment for growth. You’ll develop a sought-after perspective by connecting technology and business value, tackle real-life challenges across diverse industries, and collaborate with inspiring multidisciplinary teams, gaining a holistic understanding of AI and its potential to drive transformation.
Your Qualifications and Skills
Bachelors, Masters or PhD level in a discipline such as: computer science, machine learning, applied statistics, mathematics, engineering or artificial intelligence
Up to 3 years of professional experience in applying machine learning and data mining techniques to real problems with copious amounts of data
Programming experience (focus on machine learning): R and/or Python (must), SPSS, SAS, Ruby, Hadoop (valued)
Ability to prototype statistical analysis and modeling algorithms and apply these algorithms for data driven solutions to problems in new domains
Ability to independently own and drive model development, balancing demands and deadlines
Demonstrated aptitude for analytics
While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, we often leverage the following technologies: Python, PySpark, the PyData stack, SQL, Airflow, Databricks, our own open-source data pipelining framework called Kedro, Dask/RAPIDS, container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, cloud solutions such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, and more
Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
Willingness to travel
Good presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to people from other fields
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s), with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

About us:
Luno is the crypto investment app you can rely on, enabling you to buy, store and explore crypto securely. We’re committed to putting the power of cryptocurrency in everyone's hands sensibly and responsibly.
Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world invest safely in crypto. We do this by cutting through the hype and supporting customers at every step of the way. All products and cryptocurrencies on our platform must first meet stringent legal, risk and technical security standards.
Transparency is key for us. Luno stores all crypto on a 1:1 basis and we have rigorous processes in place so you can be confident your investment is secure. We’re available in more than 40 countries around the world and we work closely with respective regulators in all of these markets to be fully compliant, as we believe this is the best way to help everyone, everywhere, invest safely.
About the team:
The Data community at Luno, comprising Data Engineers, Scientists and Analysts, uncovers valuable insights from the vast amounts of data we gather from our customers and platform. These insights are crucial for guiding our product development and business strategy.
As a Product Data Scientist joining Luno, you would be part of the Product Analytics team providing high quality insights into our product through experimentation and advanced analytics.
Our current technology stack includes Databricks, Thoughtspot, Amplitude and Segment.
The role in a nutshell:
As we accelerate on our mission to put crypto in everyone’s hands, your role is to use data and insights to drive better product decisions and influence the Luno product strategy. This will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to find, size, prioritise, evaluate and iterate on problems and opportunities to enhance our product.
This is a hands-on product analytics role focused on experimentation, customer behaviour and data-informed decision-making. While there may be opportunities to apply modelling or machine learning techniques for specific use cases, this is not a production ML-focused role.
Your mission will be:
Partner with cross-functional product teams including Product Managers, Designers and Engineers to provide product analytics for data-informed decisions.
Partner with product and marketing teams to evaluate and optimise growth initiatives across acquisition, activation, retention and re-engagement.
Empower teams with the data, tools and skills required to prioritise initiatives and shape the product roadmap.
Design and implement event tracking data to unlock actionable insights.
Define, understand, and test opportunities and levers to improve the product through insights and recommendations.
Partner with product and marketing teams to design high-quality experiments, interpret results and ensure learnings translate into action.
Apply analytical techniques such as segmentation, funnel and cohort analysis to deeply understand customer behaviours and journeys.
Use data and analytics to inform, influence and support execution of the product strategy.
A little about you:
You enjoy using data to understand complex customer behaviour and turn ambiguity into clear, actionable insights.
You approach problems in a structured way, forming hypotheses, testing assumptions and iterating based on evidence.
You’re comfortable influencing product and growth decisions without direct ownership, using data, clear reasoning and storytelling.
You can balance speed and analytical rigour, knowing when fast, directional insight is more valuable than perfectly polished analysis.
You communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting your message to your audience.
You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional partners and value collective outcomes over individual credit.
You’re curious by nature and motivated to keep learning as tools, techniques and the data landscape evolve.
The ideal Lunaut will have:
Typically 3+ years of experience in a data, analytics or product analytics role.
A strong foundation in quantitative disciplines such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or Economics (degree or equivalent practical experience).
Experience partnering with cross-functional product teams to influence product direction, prioritisation and decision-making using data.
Demonstrable experience designing, analysing and interpreting experiments (e.g. A/B tests) in a product environment.
Hands-on experience working with event-level product data to understand customer behaviour and journeys.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
Experience using data visualisation and BI tools (e.g. Thoughtspot or similar) to communicate insights.
Working proficiency in Python (or similar) for analysis and statistical work.
The ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear analytical questions and actionable insights.
Confidence communicating data-driven insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfort operating in fast-moving, evolving environments and adapting your approach as context changes.
An interest in crypto and financial products, and curiosity to learn more about the space.
Life at Luno:
Remote but reachable work policy gives you the freedom to choose between working from home or the office.
Plus the option to buy and sell up to 5 days leave
Improve body and mind, with excellent private medical insurance
Access to Learnably and our additional learning platforms for your personal and professional development
6 months primary care-giver leave
Paw-ternity leave for your furry friend
Annual Inspiration Day in addition to your annual leave which increases based on your length of service!
A collaborative, friendly work community, with regular social events.
0 fees up to a certain amount with Luno from the day you start.*
*Offer only available on Luno Instant Buy, not Luno Exchange

Researcher at Amnesty International South Africa

Job Description
As Amnesty International’s Researcher and lead expert on South Africa, you will drive the development and delivery of a comprehensive, evidence-based research strategy aligned with AISA’s strategic priorities and overall theory of change.
This role is responsible for producing timely, accurate, independent and impartial research; ensuring full compliance with Amnesty’s research and quality assurance standards; overseeing effective research management; and delivering robust analysis and credible evidence to inform reactive, ongoing and emerging areas of work.
Roles and Responsibilities
Lead on the development, implementation and delivery of a relevant and high-impact research strategy based on agreed priorities in South Africa.
Be proactive in gathering of information, evidence and data around human rights violations in South Africa and produce it in a format to allow it to be utilised by the campaigns, media, growth and fundraising teams.
Monitor, research, investigate and analyse human rights-related developments in order to provide timely, accurate, independent and impartial assessments and expert advice on the human rights situation that is relevant to South Africa.
Organise, take part in and lead in field and remote research, leading specifically on information-gathering, fact-finding, analysis and assessment of human rights concerns, including in response to crisis situations.
Prepare, where necessary, security assessments, political and other briefings in relation to the travel and meetings for management, research teams and internal or external stakeholders; and represent AISA in the field.
Where agreed, represent AISA with external stakeholders, including in governmental, inter-governmental and at various public forums, as well as to all forms of news media, civil society organisations and political, economic and other actors; and to communicate AISA’s concerns, positions and, where relevant, campaign strategies to external and internal stakeholders.
Develop and maintain effective constituencies of public and confidential contacts and partners in and outside the organisation - such as human rights activists, members of legal and other professions, UN agencies and governmental representatives - to optimise information gathering and verification and the development and implementation of effective strategies and plans.
Timeously write research outputs, including reports and policy briefs, and develop other research-based materials for publication and internal use and contribute to, and provide expert advice, in relation to written and other materials produced by other members of the AISA team.
Manage AISA research projects and oversee the research work carried out by partners and university chapters as appropriate.
Qualifications And Requirements
A Degree in Social Sciences, Law, Economics, Development, Human Rights or any other related fields.
Honours or Masters’ Degree a definite advantage
At least five years of experience in working in a similar position.
In depth knowledge of the international human rights legal framework and proven experience of undertaking research on human rights, including economic, social and cultural rights or related issues and producing research outputs.
Specialist knowledge of South Africa and an in-depth understanding of the nature of key human rights concerns, as well as historical, political, social, legal, economic, cultural, ethnic, racial and gender issues in them.
Experience of conducting qualitative research including experience of interviewing and dealing in an appropriate manner with witnesses and survivors of human rights violations, as well as with senior government officials, policy makers, and law enforcement officials.
Familiarity with interdisciplinary research methods, including quantitative methods and use of participatory approaches, methodologies and tools when working with rights holders, partners, AISA staff/activists and others is an advantage.
Ability to analyse large sets of data and information and draw relevant conclusions related to human rights concerns according to international law and standards.
Ability to exercise good political judgment, thorough analysis and diplomacy to develop effective strategies to impact on human rights in South Africa and globally.
An ability to understand and express ideas in English in a fluent, clear and concise way, both orally and in writing is essential [and, where applicable, other relevant languages is advantageous].
Proven experience of writing research materials for a variety of audiences, together with an understanding of the importance of tailoring materials for various target audiences including through digital channels, including for example substantial reports, policy briefs, government correspondence, presentations at national and international conferences and media and action materials.
Ability to work to tight deadlines, with experience of managing conflicting demands, meeting deadlines and adjusting priorities.
A commitment to adherence with Amnesty’s quality assurance processes

descriptions.description:
Join Ricoh Europe as a Global Business Intelligence Architect
At Ricoh, we believe in the power of technology to transform the way people work and shape the future. We are looking for a talented Business Intelligence Architect to join our global team and contribute to driving data‑led decision-making across the Ricoh Family Group worldwide.
Why Ricoh
Joining Ricoh means becoming part of an international organisation that values diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning. You will work with advanced technologies such as Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, MS Fabric, SQL, Python, SharePoint, and Snowflake, within a flexible hybrid model that supports a healthy work–life balance. You will also benefit from development programmes designed to help you grow your career in a dynamic and evolving global environment.
What You Will Do
In this role, you will help design and strengthen Ricoh’s global data architecture, working closely with international teams to deliver solutions that contribute to strategic decision‑making. Your responsibilities will include:
Designing and developing backend SQL solutions (ETL/SSIS) to support global Power BI reporting.
Creating Power Apps and user-friendly interfaces that enable efficient data management.
Enhancing and expanding the data infrastructure by integrating new architectures and data sources.
Ensuring robust data governance, security, and compliance with GDPR.
Supporting continuous improvement through the development of global KPIs and data quality processes.
Documenting technical processes and creating clear BI documentation for internal use.
Collaborating with technical teams and stakeholders across regions to ensure solutions align with strategic priorities.
What We’re Looking For
This position is based in Gauteng (Johannesburg), although we may also consider applicants located in other parts of South Africa.
We are seeking someone with a solid technical foundation and the ability to operate in a complex, multicultural, and innovation‑driven environment. We value:
A relevant academic background (Computer Science, Data Engineering, or similar). A bachelor’s degree is desirable.
3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role.
Proven expertise in Power Platform and Copilot Studio.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric and Dataverse.
Strong skills in SQL Server development, data warehousing, and ETL processes.
Experience building business‑oriented tools for reporting and dashboards.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Familiarity with Python, data modelling, and governance best practices.
Experience in machine learning or advanced analytics (an advantage).
Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Power BI, Azure) and experience using GitHub for version control (highly desirable).
Soft Skills We Value
Clear communication with both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Analytical thinking and effective problem‑solving.
Strong organisational and time‑management skills.
Adaptability and flexibility in a global setting.
Teamwork, collaboration, and a customer‑focused mindset.
Initiative, proactivity, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
A commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
What’s In It For You
At Ricoh, your growth is as important as your contribution. We offer:
A competitive salary.
Statutory leave in line with South African labour legislation.
Hybrid or remote work options, depending on the role and team requirements.
Access to an Employee Assistance Programme for wellbeing support.
Continuous learning opportunities to support your professional development.
Join Us
Ricoh is a place where your ideas have impact and your development matters.
If you’re ready for a meaningful career move, apply now for a confidential conversation with our Recruitment Team.

descriptions.title: General Manager: Frontline Customer Service Management
descriptions.description:
Mission/Core purpose of the Job
•The General Manager of Frontline Customer Service Management is responsible for enhancing customer loyalty, retention, and satisfaction through strategic and operational initiatives. This role involves developing and implementing retention and loyalty strategies, managing customer service operations, and leveraging technology to improve customer experience and satisfaction.
Key Activities & Responsibilities (but not limited to)
Strategic Planning
•Develop and implement retention and loyalty strategies/concepts for retention/growth initiatives.
•Provide input into the design of the strategic roadmap to define the measurement of process performance impacting customer churn, sales campaigns, and all other sales activity that drive revenue.
•Translate MTN SA’s long-term strategy into a mid-term strategy and devise operational objectives for CX Operations and Service Management
•Consider the future reality and align planning against the strategic intent of the company. Includes supporting business objectives (customer experience and related activities, churn management and reduction) by proposing and implementing the effective and efficient operational framework i.e. (concepts and approaches) for all touch points in the lifecycle of a business customer.
•Manage strategic and operational performance and measures, driving corporate culture and profitability through control mechanisms
Operations (Systems, Procedures and Processes)
•Manage MTN's operational contact centres (frontline) and retention channels via in-house teams as well as outsourced vendors.
•Ensure that performance levels are on target and delivered in accordance with the contract and statement of work.
•Formulate, implement, and manage performance recovery plans if and when the situation requires.
•Facilitate, support, implement, and manage any operational change management or transformation plans.
•Formulate, implement, and manage various overlay incentive programs to drive incremental performance levels.
•Implement and drive regular performance benchmarking exercises between the vendors to create a healthy competitive environment.
•Ensure that all outsource partners are fully supported in all areas by MTN to maximize performance levels.
•Drive MTN SA’s service delivery and customer service satisfaction vision.
•Anticipate and analyze trends and highlight areas of the business that may be developed further.
•Manage strategic and operational performance and measures, driving corporate culture and profitability through control mechanisms.
•Integrate the various functional paths, manage them into a unified whole with a clear direction and leverage internal capability for competitive advantage.
•Provide strong, dynamic leadership that mentors, develops, and guides team members to efficiently leverage the value of every call.
•Ensure that agents meet and/or exceed daily call center benchmarks (KPI’s) that include SLA’s on answer percentage, AHT, etc.
•Translate business and customer experience requirements into operational objectives, goals, and work processes of the CX Operations environment.
•Ensure resources are obtained, used, and coordinated in a way that allows the company to achieve its mission.
•Ensure all operational activities are regularly reviewed, designed, and documented in policy, processes, and procedure using proper Document Management Systems to meet changing business and customer needs.
•Keep abreast of technological developments to ensure that MTN is at the forefront of global technology trends.
Operations (Systems, Procedures and Processes) Continued…
•Implement and ensure optimal use of technology in support of customer experience initiatives and business objectives.
•Drive development and continuous improvement of technology and ensure that it adds value to the Customer Service Operations unit.
•Ensure the regular update of customer service’s systems and processes to meet customer and business requirements.
•Review, modify, design, and implement systems to ensure all customer touch points (both voice and non-voice channels) meet marketing requirements and are aligned to global best practices.
•Suggest corrective measures, considering future consequences of actions on the viability of the business and on customer satisfaction.
•Ensure effective customer experience support is provided to all sales channels, retailers, and partners.
Operational Service Management Compliance Management
•In conjunction with Business Risk and the CX Governance and Compliance team ensure that operational audits and health checks are completed and reported on regularly to ensure risks are identified and mitigated against
•Ensure that all vendors operational processes, systems, facilities and infrastructure are secure and compliant in accordance with the various and relevant legislative requirements and best practice.
•Monitor, tracking and reporting of all vendors/in-house teams risks, which may relate to legislation, best practice adherence and/or the contract.
•Co-create, oversee and ensure the implementation of an integrated risk assessment and management framework
•Continuously assess compliance to and efficacy of established processes, policies and procedures
Customer and Partner Satisfaction
•Represent the MTN brand internally and externally and ensure reputational risk is effectively managed
•Function as an integral source of expertise on the design and implementation of the integrated customer management strategy that is aligned to business value chain
•Establish, communicate, drive and monitor quality targets
•Understand customer and partner needs, develop, and fine-tune systems and service delivery accordingly
•Build and maintain solid relationships with all stakeholders and ensure effective and consistent delivery of excellent customer experience.
•Assist in the alignment of service delivery to changing business needs and ensure effective customer and stakeholder management.
•Build a reputation for meeting customer and partner contact and service strategies, internally within MTN and externally, to ensure leadership in the Telco call centre market.
•Investigate, research and maximize technology to provide state of the art customer service.
Project Management
•Identify Business Improvement and Optimisation opportunities that will result in improvement of performance and customer experience
•Review business cases for initiatives proposed by the business. Research and consider best practice, local conditions, trends, as well as competitor activity
•Determine, document, and review requirements for projects within the scope of the value stream or impacting processes and systems
•Champion and enable innovative projects and change programmes in the division and ensure project portfolios are aligned to the Customer Experience vision
•Monitor and analyse impact and costs of specific projects and programmes and facilitate project reporting and compliance
Budget and Financial Management
•Forecast, plan, develop and review budget for the CX Operations unit and secure necessary approvals
•Ensure corporate credibility by providing timely and accurate analysis of budgets, financial trends, forecasts and reports
•Manage and optimize the budget, ensuring all expenditure is in line with the agreed budgets
•Monitor costs and determine initiatives to increase efficiencies and optimize resources - maximise cost/benefit ratios
•Identify and exploit opportunities to generate additional revenue
•Base annual budgets on the identification of trends and patterns within the current operations and extrapolate these over the next planning cycle, taking any known changes in new products or services into consideration
•Full contractual and commercial management of all indirect (non face to face) sales and retention vendors
•Ensure that the correct and relevant targets are agreed, contracted, managed, and reported on – sales, saves, conversions, SLA, etc.
•Ensure that all vendors legal contracts and commercial models are implemented and reflected in the daily, weekly and monthly performance levels and outputs
•Ensure that the various operations are delivered within the approved financial budget, penalties applied and/ or over achievement rewards paid
•Ensure that all MTN company financial targets are met
•Ensure Vendor & IT costs are effectively managed
Business Reporting and Analysis
•Collates, analyses and summarizes data and trends to produce high value management information that supports strategic decision-making
•Leverage business analytics, networks and technology to optimize existing process flows, business intelligence and customer service
•Continuously perform statistical analysis and assessment of the CX Operations’ productivity, and report periodically to the CX Executive on qualitative and quantitative results (including budget and SLA compliance and feedback reports)
•Ensure that global benchmarking is conducted with other companies and organizations within and outside the industry.
Education
•Bachelor’s degree required; preferably in Economics, Statistics, Finance, Marketing Analytics, Telecommunications, IT, or related field.
•Post Graduate Degree in Economics, Finance, or MBA is advantageous.
Experience
•Minimum 10 years of Customer Services experience with at least 5 at a senior level.
•More than 8 years of contact center and BPO experience.
•More than 10 years of managing vendor operations specific to performance, commercial, and contractual level.
•Relevant Telco industry experience.
•Demonstrable commercial and business acumen with experience in making significant business decisions.
•Proven track record of working with ExCo and leadership teams.
•Proven track record of leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop large groups of people through several levels of management.
•Proven record of delivering high standards of service and experience.
•Proven track record of delivering creative and flexible customer solutions.

Position at Aculocity, LLC
BI Developer (Intermediate)
Description
Position at GVW Group, South Africa
Job Description:
We are seeking a skilled and experienced BI Developer with expertise in Power BI to join our team. Your primary role will be to transform raw data into actionable insights through compelling visualizations that drive strategic business decisions. The ideal candidate will possess a strong analytical mindset, advanced problem-solving skills, and a passion for data-driven storytelling.
You will work closely with stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize Power BI dashboards, reports, and data models, ensuring high performance, scalability, and usability. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and is excited about solving complex data challenges.
Responsibilities:
Partner with business stakeholders to gather and understand their requirements and translate them into actionable data solutions.
Develop, test, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations, ensuring they provide high-level insights in an intuitive and impactful format.
Design and optimize semantic data models using Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, ensuring consistent and accurate data flow across various reporting applications. Write and troubleshoot complex DAX queries for calculated measures and columns.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, create views, stored procedures (SPs); able to read and modify existing SQL code for business requirements.
Connect Power BI to a wide range of data sources, including SQL databases, APIs, and cloud platforms, ensuring seamless integration and efficient data retrieval.
Implement best practices for Power BI performance optimization, including query optimization, query folding, aggregation tables, and proper indexing to enhance report performance.
Provide end-user training and ongoing support to help stakeholders leverage Power BI effectively, ensuring high adoption and user satisfaction across the organization.
Assist with managing Power BI Service, including supporting workspace management, ensuring smooth report deployment, helping with user access, and troubleshooting basic performance and connectivity issues.
Document technical specifications, data models, processes, and reporting standards for future reference and knowledge sharing.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of work experience using Power BI, with a proven track record of delivering successful projects and solving complex problems. Proficient in writing advanced DAX.
Strong understanding of data visualization principles and best practices.
Experience with SQL and data modeling (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema).
Familiarity with ETL processes and tools.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
Curiosity, enthusiasm, positive attitude, a passion to build, and a willingness to seek and learn new concepts.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

descriptions.title: Marketing Analyst
descriptions.description:
Marketing Analyst
Are you passionate about data, analytics, and turning complex marketing performance insights into clear, actionable recommendations? Join a purpose‑driven Australian pet insurance company and help us optimise, measure, and elevate our digital performance across channels.
We are launching a new pet insurance brand in Australia, and looking for a Marketing Analyst, based in South Africa, to take ownership of marketing analytics, tracking, and integrated reporting across our digital ecosystem.
Where you’ll work
Either remotely within South Africa or, at our office in the beautiful town of George in the heart of South Africa’s stunning Garden Route.
Working hours will be semi-aligned to the Australian time zone: 06:00 to 15:00 SA time giving you more free time later in your day!
About the Role
As our Marketing Analyst, you will be the backbone of marketing measurement and insight generation. You will build and maintain our tracking infrastructure (GA4, GTM, UTM frameworks), manage our marketing measurement framework and tagging dictionary, and create performance dashboards that bring together data from multiple channels and platforms (Power BI, GA4, Qlik Sense).
You’ll work closely with the Digital Marketing Specialist, front‑end developer, and external agencies to ensure data accuracy, diagnose performance drivers, optimise campaigns, and provide visibility across acquisition and conversion funnels. This role is ideal for someone who loves structure, detail, problem‑solving, and helping a marketing team make better, faster, data‑driven decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Marketing Analytics & Measurement
Own and optimise tagging and digital measurement across GA4, GTM, and UTM frameworks.
Maintain the marketing measurement framework and GA4 tagging dictionary.
Define and validate all campaign tracking requirements with the Digital Marketing Specialist.
Build and maintain GA4 dashboards and custom reporting views.
Develop detailed marketing performance dashboards in Power BI, integrating campaign, lead, conversion, and spend data.
Marketing Reporting & Performance Monitoring
Deliver daily, weekly, and monthly marketing performance dashboards and reports.
Track results against KPIs, identify trends and variances, and highlight efficiency improvement opportunities.
Build integrated marketing performance reports across channels and platforms.
Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to enhance Qlik Sense dashboards.
Partner with the call centre team to understand lead quality and feed operational insights into marketing performance analysis.
Campaign Performance Analysis
Analyse cross‑channel campaign performance and diagnose what’s driving results.
Evaluate CPL, CPS, conversion rates, cancellation rates, and ROI.
Present clear, actionable insights and recommendations to guide media investment and channel strategy.
Competitor & Market Insights
Monitor competitor digital activity and indicative media spend.
Prepare quarterly competitor and market performance reviews to support planning and channel optimisation.
Customer Experience & Brand Tracking
Analyse NPS, customer feedback, brand tracking studies, and complaint data.
Identify trends and insights to support improvements in messaging, brand positioning, and customer experience.
Industry Knowledge & Continuous Improvement
Stay up to date with advancements in analytics, attribution modelling, and measurement tools.
Identify opportunities to improve forecasting, measurement accuracy, or analytical methodologies.
Essential Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Data Analytics or similar.
3+ years’ experience in marketing analytics or performance reporting.
Hands‑on experience with GA4, GTM, and UTM frameworks.
Strong experience building detailed dashboards in GA4 and Power BI.
Advantageous: experience enhancing Qlik Sense dashboards with BI teams.
Strong data interpretation, problem‑solving, and analytical capability.
Advanced Excel skills.
Good understanding of digital marketing channels and tracking structures.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Bonus Points For
Experience in insurance, financial services, or regulated industries.
Experience working with Australian companies or markets.
A passion for pets or the pet care industry.
Strong organisation and project‑management skills.
Why work with us?
At Pacific International Insurance, we're not just about policies, we're about pets. Join a team that values innovation, purpose, and creating Soft Landings. You'll be helping pet owners across Australia make informed, stress-free decisions about their pets’ health and wellbeing.
Ready to Apply?
If you are a curious, detail‑driven analyst who loves translating data into meaningful insights that drive performance, we’d love to meet you.
Apply now and help us build smarter, more impactful marketing—one insight at a time.

Ensure cohesive collaboration between the Analyst team, Data Operations, and other Technology functions to enable smooth data flow, system interoperability, and shared accountability.
Oversee the design, development, and delivery of high-quality dashboards, reports, and visual insights in tools such as Power BI, ensuring they are well-documented, performant, and aligned to user needs.
Partner with Data Operations, Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity teams to maintain and optimise data product environments (e.g., Power BI domains and workspaces) for secure, efficient access and reliable performance.
Embed key dashboards, insights, and triggers into stakeholder workflows, supporting their integration into daily decision cycles and organisational rhythms, and providing documentation and training to support adoption and maximisation of value.
Develop and implement a data communications and literacy strategy, in collaboration with CV’s communications team, to make data resources, catalogues, and knowledge bases accessible, visible, and well-understood.
Champion data-informed culture across CV by deploying enablement resources, providing tailored guidance to non-technical users, and modelling excellence in data storytelling and interpretation.
Track adoption, performance, and impact of data products, establishing metrics and feedback loops to drive iterative improvement and demonstrate business value.
Act as a strategic business analyst and cross-functional connector, partnering with Mission, Governance, and other Functions to ensure analytics solutions are aligned with CV’s strategic goals and empower self-service insight across the organisation.
As part of a global organisation, you will be required to collaborate across time zones, which may involve out-of-hours availability.
General Responsibilities
Fulfil all duties outlined above for this specific role, and as directed below for all team members within CV. This includes, but is not limited to:
Actively pursue personal, professional, and spiritual growth.
Contribute positively to our team culture by upholding CV’s values in attitude and action.
Comply with all CV policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate integrity in all matters.
Engage fully in staff and team meetings, collaboration, and communication.
Commit to continuous learning and development as needed for the role.
Foster respectful, clear, and constructive communication across all interactions.
A practising Christian in full agreement with the CV Statement of Faith.
Actively involved in a local church or Christian faith community.
Committed to living according to biblical values.
Skills, Experience And Education
At least 5 years of experience as a data analyst, BI developer and product manager with strong expertise in enterprise deployment and adoption of data analytics tools and platforms such as Power BI/Fabric, Tableau, Looker, Qlik, etc.
Bachelors degree in a numerate or analytical discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, data science or operational research. Postgraduate or professional qualifications with an emphasis on product management would be an advantage.
Strong data analysis skills using tools such as SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, Python, etc. Experience in the use of AI tools and agents for analytics and insight generation would be an advantage.
Strong analytical and product management skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into application and operational requirements which provide intuitive analytical outputs.
Experience with enterprise data models or data warehouses
Familiarity with data governance and security best practices and commitment to championing data privacy, quality, and stewardship
Demonstrated proficiency in managing technical and human resources to provide data solutions and services.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to interact professionally cross-functionally and cross-culturally across all levels of the organisation. Experience of working internationally and cross-culturally would be an advantage.
Experience in collaborative team working, contributing to and encouraging a culture of service delivery of the highest quality.
Ability to think and act creatively, and adaptably to problem solve.
Ability to successfully engage in multiple initiatives simultaneously.

descriptions.description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.
What We Do
The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.
About The Role
GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Machine Learning expert, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.
Although every project is unique, you might typically:
Design original computational STEM problems that simulate real scientific workflows
Create problems that require Python programming to solve
Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains and creative problem-solving approaches
Verify solutions using Python with standard libraries (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
Document problem statements clearly and provide verified correct answers
How To Get Started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.
Requirements
You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a similar STEM field
You have at least 5 years of Machine Learning experience with proven business impact
Strong programming skills in Python (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
Solid understanding of numerical methods and computational algorithms
Research or industry experience involving computational problem-solving
Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge
Benefits
Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?
Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $32/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

descriptions.description:
Company Description
SABiSS is a software development company specializing in creating, maintaining, and supporting advanced solutions for the retail industry. We focus on delivering innovative software for time and attendance systems as well as fintech solutions. Our products are widely adopted, helping businesses streamline their operations. At SABiSS, we are committed to providing efficient solutions that align with the dynamic needs of the retail sector.
Senior Software Engineer | FinTech & HR Systems
Location: East London, Eastern Cape (Hybrid) Experience: 8+ Years Type: Permanent
Position Overview
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience to enhance the development and optimisation of our core platforms. Our firm specialises in high-availability systems, specifically closed-loop payment ecosystems, loyalty programmes, and enterprise-grade time and attendance solutions.
The successful candidate will be responsible for the full lifecycle of complex software components and industry infrastructure best practices.
Technical Requirements
Candidates must demonstrate mastery in the following areas:
Core Development: C#, .NET 8/9/10, and ASP.NET Core.
Frontend Frameworks: Experience with modern Web and Mobile front end frameworks (Advantageous)
Data Architecture: Microsoft Fabric (OneLake) and advanced SQL optimisation. (Advantageous)
Distributed Systems: Microservices architecture experience - REST/gRPC
Infrastructure: Container orchestration with Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, and Azure Cloud environments.
Business Intelligence: Implementation and management of Apache Superset (or equivalent visualisation frameworks).
Primary Responsibilities
System Architecture: Design and maintain scalable microservices that handle high-concurrency financial transactions and workforce data.
Data Engineering: Oversee the transition of legacy data structures into a unified OneLake/Fabric architecture to support real-time analytics. (Advantageous)
Security & Compliance: Ensure all payment and loyalty systems adhere to industry-standard security protocols and relevant compliance regulations.
DevOps Oversight: Assist in managing deployment pipelines and containerised environments to ensure system stability and minimal downtime.
Technical Leadership: Provide high-level code reviews, documentation, and architectural guidance to the broader development team in collaboration with development consultants.
Qualifications & Experience
BSc/BEng in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related tertiary qualification.
8+ years of verifiable experience in software engineering.
Proven track record in building, maintaining and modern transactional systems.
Understanding of the South African fintech and labour regulatory landscape is advantageous.
Must be based in, or willing to relocate to, East London for a hybrid office-based role.
Remuneration & Environment
Market-related CTC salary commensurate with senior-level experience.
Hybrid work structure providing a balance between collaborative office presence and remote focused work.
A stable, professional environment focused on long-term product excellence.

We are passionate about building scalable, reliable machine learning systems that create real customer impact. Our team blends technical excellence with enjoyment—we learn continuously, solve meaningful problems, and celebrate the solutions we deliver. descriptions.title: AI Engineer
descriptions.description:
IoT.nxt is a leading IoT technology company enabling real-time visibility, actionable insights and control, powered by AI. Our award-winning platform uses the internet of things, digital twins, and machine learning to help businesses reduce costs, maximize process efficiency and eliminate risk. Our technology enables businesses to run more agile, proactive and competitive operations.
The Role Purpose:
We are seeking an AI Engineer to join our team, with a primary focus on designing, developing, and maintaining production-grade software solutions that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs), embedding models, and other generative technologies. This role emphasizes building scalable, reliable, and secure agentic solutions (including multi-agent systems) for external market-facing products and internal enterprise enablement.
The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep practical capability in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge management, prompt/context engineering, model/tool orchestration, and AI governance guardrails.
The successful candidate will play a key role in building scalable systems for external market-facing products.
Your Responsibilities will include:
Design, develop, test, and deploy end-to-end GenAI-enabled software solutions (services, APIs, workflows, and product features).
Build agentic systems, including multi-agent architectures, tool-use patterns, orchestration flows, and production tooling integrations.
Design and implement RAG pipelines for both product and enterprise contexts, including knowledge-based curation, ingestion, document processing, chunking strategies, embedding generation, retrieval tuning, and answer grounding.
Develop and operationalize robust prompt and context engineering practices (prompt templating, context window management, instruction hierarchy, tool routing, and response formatting).
Implement agent memory management patterns and frameworks to support short-term and long-term memory, personalization, and session continuity (where applicable).
Integrate and operate model providers and runtimes for production use-cases, including hosted APIs and self-hosted inference, optimizing for latency, cost, throughput, and reliability.
Develop microservices and APIs that expose GenAI/agent capabilities to web applications and downstream systems; maintain strong engineering standards for versioning, observability, and backward compatibility.
Design and maintain data stores supporting GenAI applications, including relational, vector, and graph patterns to enable retrieval, reasoning, and relationship-aware experiences.
Implement AI Governance practices: apply and monitor guardrails (policy enforcement, content filtering, PII handling, prompt injection defences, auditability, and safe tool execution).
Evaluation and monitoring approaches for GenAI systems (quality, grounding, safety, latency, cost), contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, UX, Data/ML, Security, Compliance) to translate business requirements into technically sound solutions.
Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and agile planning sessions; contribute to internal standards, patterns, and reusable components.
Maintain and enhance legacy systems where required, integrating GenAI functionality safely without compromising stability.
The ideal candidate for the role will have the following qualifications, experience and knowledge:
Educational Background:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or equivalent
Postgraduate qualification in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Applied Mathematics is advantageous
Relevant certifications are advantageous (examples include Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning, or similar cloud/AI certifications).
Work Experience:
1-3 years of experience in delivering production-grade software (greenfield and brownfield), including backend services and customer-facing modules.
Proven hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI solutions in production, including LLM-powered features, RAG-based systems, or agentic workflows.
Experience implementing governance controls and operational monitoring for GenAI systems in real-world environments.
Strong practical exposure to modern software engineering practices: CI/CD, testing, code review, observability, and secure API design.
Knowledge
Strong understanding of LLM/embedding fundamentals as applied in production systems (retrieval, grounding, context shaping, evaluation, and failure modes).
Knowledge of multi-agent patterns, tool/function calling (MCP), workflow orchestration, and safe execution boundaries.
Understanding of data management strategies for GenAI (document pipelines, vector search, graph relationships, and relational integrity).
Familiarity with data privacy principles, security-by-design, and governance expectations relevant to enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Technical Skills:
Core Engineering & Platforms
Python (GenAI services, orchestration, data pipelines), C#, REST APIs, microservices, event-driven systems (Kafka).
Strong engineering fundamentals (clean architecture, testing, security, performance).
GenAI, Agents & RAG
Prompt and context engineering, agent frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel), workflow automation (e.g. n8n).
Experience with hosted and self-hosted models (OpenAI/Azure/AWS, Ollama, vLLM). RAG systems: document ingestion, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citations, and knowledge lifecycle management.
Data, Memory & Storage
PostgreSQL (incl. timescale), vector DBs (Qdrant, Milvus), graph DBs (Neo4j, Apache AGE).
Agent memory patterns (session, long-term, summarization) with privacy and risk controls.
Security, Governance & Ops
GenAI guardrails (prompt/tool injection defence, PII handling, auditing).
Cloud & DevOps (Azure/AWS, CI/CD, Git, Docker/Kubernetes). Observability for LLM systems. Agile delivery and GenAI-specific testing/evaluation.

The Data Architect applies enterprise-level frameworks, standards, and best practices—set by the Data Architect & Modeller Lead and defined by the Enterprise Data Architect—to domain-level or project-specific data solutions. Operating within the organisation’s data-driven, compliance-focused digital banking environment, the Data Architect ensures that data architectures meet business needs, align with data governance directives, and uphold regulatory requirements. This role involves translating high-level reference architectures into actionable conceptual and logical data designs that support accurate and timely risk data aggregation, enable advanced analytics (including AI/ML), and promote data quality, lineage, and security at the implementation level.
KEY RESULT AREAS
Domain-Level Architecture & Compliance:
Develop conceptual and logical data architectures for specific domains, squads, or projects, adapting enterprise frameworks to local needs while ensuring alignment with governance standards and regulatory obligations.
Integrate data quality metrics, lineage tracking, metadata standards, and privacy/security controls into data architectures, ensuring that solutions can reliably support risk data aggregation and timely reporting as mandated by international banking guidelines.
Collaboration & Documentation:
Work closely with Data Modellers, providing detailed architectural artifacts (architecture artefacts, diagrams, data flows) to guide the creation of logical and physical data models.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Governance teams, and other stakeholders to clarify architectural intent, resolve technical challenges, and ensure that resulting data solutions are both compliant and optimised for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Continuous Improvement & Adaptability:
Take part in proofs of concept (POCs), pilot projects, and sandbox initiatives to test and refine architectural approaches, ensuring flexibility and adaptability to evolving risk reporting requirements and emerging technologies.
Identify opportunities to improve domain-level architectures based on feedback from squads, changes in regulatory landscapes, advancements in analytics tools, or shifting business priorities.
Role Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field
Minimum of 6–8 years experience in data architecture, data warehousing, cloud-based BI solutions, and an understanding of data governance and regulatory frameworks in a banking or similarly regulated environment.

descriptions.description:

Recruiter:

SUMMARY:
Our client based in Isando is looking for a Security Architect with at leat 6+ years of experience in the field, coupled with NQF Level 7 qualification in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and must be TOGAF Certification.
Purpose of the Role:
The Security Architect is responsible for designing and maintaining the enterprise security architecture to safeguard systems, data, and infrastructure against evolving threats. They define and enforce security frameworks, standards, and controls, ensuring compliance with enterprise policies and regulatory requirements. The role involves assessing risks, conducting threat modelling, and embedding security-by-design into applications, data, and technology platforms. Security Architect is also responsible for guiding the adoption of identity management, access controls, encryption, and monitoring solutions. They collaborate closely with Business, Application, Data, Technology, Integration, and AI/ML Architects to ensure security is integrated across all domains. Ultimately, the Security Architect ensures the organization’s digital ecosystem is resilient, compliant, and capable of supporting innovation safely.
POSITION INFO:
Qualifications and Experience Required:
Matric plus NQF Level 7 Qualification in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
TOGAF Certification
The Security Architect has 6–8 years of experience in designing and implementing enterprise security architectures across multiple industries. They have defined and maintained security frameworks, standards, and policies that align with business strategy and regulatory requirements.
Experience includes conducting risk assessments, threat modeling, and vulnerability analysis to ensure proactive defense against evolving cyber threats.
Must have successfully led the deployment of identity and access management, encryption, endpoint protection, and SIEM solutions.
Experience in guiding organizations through compliance with frameworks and regulations such as ISO 27001, NIST, POPIA, and GDPR.
Proven expertise in security-by-design practices, embedding controls within applications, data, and technology platforms.
Background includes close collaboration with Application, Data, Technology, Integration, and AI/ML Architects to ensure security is integrated across all domains.
Must be skilled in working with executives and stakeholders, providing assurance that security investments balance risk, cost, and business value.
Must have experience in leading incident response and disaster recovery planning, ensuring organizational resilience.
Must have a strong track record of enabling secure, compliant, and innovative enterprise environments through robust security architecture.
3+ years of experience in a large-scale digital transformation, where new cloud platforms, applications, and data flows need to be secured end-to-end.
Design the enterprise security architecture, embedding controls such as identity management, encryption, and monitoring into all layers of the ecosystem.
Aligning security with compliance requirements and industry best practices, they reduce risk while enabling innovation. This results in a resilient and trusted digital environment that supports business growth and transformation safely.
Role Description:
Security Architecture Design:
Define and maintain the enterprise security blueprint covering applications, data, infrastructure, and integrations.
Risk Assessment and Thread Modelling
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks through proactive security design and controls.
Compliance and Governance
Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, POPIA, GDPR) and enterprise policies.
Identity and Access Management
Oversee authentication, authorization, and privilege management across systems.
Security by Design and Integration:
Embed security into applications, data, technology, and AI/ML initiatives from the design stage.
Incident Response and Resilience:
Support incident response, monitoring, and disaster recovery planning to ensure continuity.
Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:
Partner with other architects, executives, and delivery teams to align security with business value and innovation.

descriptions.title: Cloud Solutions Architect - Alliances
descriptions.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Cloud Solutions Architect in our Alliances team to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.
Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.
We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.
We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.
Location: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.
What your day will look like
Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments
Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX
Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical's technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center
Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners
Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners' teams to promote Canonical products and solutions
If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Architect role at Canonical.
What we are looking for in you
Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation
Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds
Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills
Fluent written and spoken English
Excellent communication and presentation skills
High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments
Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs
Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps
Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time
Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

descriptions.title: Data Governance Lead (Senior Manager)
descriptions.description:
As the Data Governance Lead, you will be the strategic architect and delivery leader for enterprise data and AI governance. You will translate executive objectives into actionable operating models, policies and controls, and lead multi-disciplinary teams to implement governance across cloud data platforms and AI solutions. You will align closely with DAMA-DMBOK best practices, drive regulatory compliance, uplift data quality, and enable trusted, innovative analytics.
Key responsibilities Strategy and operating model (DAMA-aligned)
Own the data and AI governance strategy, roadmap and maturity uplift (DAMA-DMBOK; DCAM familiarity beneficial).
Establish and run the governance operating model: councils/committees, stewardship community, RACI, policy lifecycle, standards and control library.
Define and track governance OKRs/KPIs; perform maturity assessments and periodic control effectiveness reviews.
Policy and control framework
Define enterprise policies and standards for data classification, ownership/accountability, critical data elements (CDEs), metadata and lineage, data quality, access and entitlements, retention/disposal, data sharing and third-party data risk.
Map controls to regulations and frameworks (GDPR, POPIA) HIPAA, PCI DSS/SOX as applicable.
Data quality management
Identify CDEs, define business rules and thresholds across DQ dimensions (accuracy, completeness, timeliness, consistency, uniqueness, validity).
Implement profiling, monitoring and issue management; lead remediation programs, root-cause analysis and preventive controls; set data SLAs/SLOs and data contracts.
Metadata, catalog and lineage
Stand up and scale business glossaries, technical metadata and end-to-end lineage in tools such as Collibra, Alation, Informatica or Purview.
Design stewardship workflows, certifications and community-of-practice enablement; measure adoption and curation quality.
Data architecture and modelling governance
Partner with Data Architects to embed governance in reference architectures, data product standards and integration patterns across AWS/Azure/GCP.
Define and enforce modelling standards (Kimball dimensional modelling, star schemas, SCDs, semantic layer governance) and review boards.
Govern ELT/ETL patterns, DataOps practices, versioning, code reviews and documentation standards.
Master and reference data governance
Establish MDM policies and processes (match/merge, survivorship, golden records) with appropriate stewardship and data domain ownership.
Privacy, security and ethical use
Embed privacy-by-design: DPIAs, consent management, minimisation, de-identification/tokenisation, data sovereignty and cross-border transfer governance.
Govern access (RBAC/ABAC), segregation-of-duties and DLP; oversee sensitive data discovery and classification.
AI governance
Implement AI/model risk governance: model inventory, risk classification, approvals, human-in-the-loop, documentation (model/data cards), explainability, bias/fairness testing, drift/monitoring and incident response.
Align to EU AI Act obligations; integrate governance into MLOps pipelines and feature stores.
Change leadership and delivery
Lead complex, multi-workstream governance implementations; manage scope, budget, risk and stakeholders; integrate change management and training/adoption plans.
Coach and develop Data Stewards, BAs and Engineers; build internal capability and reusable accelerators.
Consulting and practice development
Contribute to pre-sales, solutioning, proposals and SOWs; author thought leadership and POVs; represent PwC in client forums and industry events.
Required qualifications and experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Information Management, Business Administration or related field.
7–12 years in data governance/data management with 2+ years in a leadership role; professional services/consulting or technology environments preferred.
DAMA certification: CDMP (Associate/Practitioner/Master). If not currently certified, willingness to obtain within 12 months.
Proven background as a BI Business Analyst or Data Architect, including hands-on Kimball dimensional modelling and close partnership with engineering teams.
Demonstrated delivery of governance capabilities on cloud and on premises platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data stacks (e.g., lakehouse/warehouse, ELT/ETL, DataOps).
Hands-on implementation experience with governance tools (catalog, glossary, lineage, stewardship workflows).
Strong data quality, metadata and MDM governance experience.
Solid knowledge of data privacy/security regulations (GDPR, POPIA) and AI governance frameworks.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence C-level and coach domain stewards.
Proven track record managing complex programs and cross-functional teams in dynamic environments.
Preferred certifications and skills
Additional certifications Agile/SAFe.
Experience with data product governance and data mesh operating models.
Working knowledge of BI and analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau), semantic modelling.
Experience integrating governance with DevOps/DataOps/MLOps toolchains (e.g., Git, CI/CD, feature stores, model registries).
Core competencies
Governance design: Operating model definition, policy/control design, RACI and stewardship.
Regulatory alignment: Pragmatic control mapping and audit-readiness.
Technical depth: Data modelling (Kimball), lineage, DQ/MDM, catalog workflows, access/entitlements.
AI governance: Risk-based controls across the ML lifecycle.
Change and adoption: Training, communications, community building and measurable uptake.
Consulting excellence: Problem framing, value articulation, proposal development and storytelling.
