DATA SCIENTIST: WAFUNDA ISA
Role: Full-time, permanent
Start Date: 1 April 2026 (or as soon as possible)
Location: Cape Town
Salary range: R40,000 - R60,000 CTC per month (experience dependent)
Closing date: 20 March 2026
WaFunda, an education-focused impact organisation, is looking for an analytical, data-driven, solution-oriented, and detail-focused Data Scientist to join our team and support our ethical and innovative student financing product. WaFunda’s response to the student funding crisis in South Africa is an innovative, fair, and ethical education financing tool called an Income Share Agreement (ISA). An ISA mimics some of the characteristics of a Stokvel and allows students to receive financing for their post secondary education without the risks associated with traditional loans. Joining WaFunda means you will be engaging in meaningful work. Our company is young and our team is diverse and passionate about South Africa. We approach our work with authenticity, accountability, and collaboration.
JOB DESCRIPTION
The Data Scientist will be responsible for developing and refining WaFunda’s data approach, instituting effective data protocols, and managing data warehousing. This role will focus on data modeling, reporting, and ensuring that data collection, analysis, and reporting are accurate and clear. The Data Scientist will work closely with the Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) and repayments teams to provide data-driven insights that support decision-making and the organisation’s mission to deliver ethical and innovative student financing solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and refine data approach: Lead the development and execution of WaFunda’s data strategy, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and continuous improvement in data practices.
Process automation and continuous improvement: Drive the automation of key processes to enhance efficiency and reduce lead times. Regularly review and refine automated workflows to ensure they remain effective, up-to-date, and aligned with organizational needs and goals.
Institute data protocols, warehousing and software audits: Establish data protocols for collection, storage, and access, ensuring a scalable and efficient data warehousing system. Conduct regular software audits to ensure compliance, security, and optimal performance of data management tools and systems.
Data modelling and reporting: Create, maintain, and support data models that enable reporting, statistical analysis for trend forecasting, and visualisation, ensuring insights are actionable and relevant to stakeholders.
Data collection, cleaning and management: Collect, clean, validate, and organise data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all datasets.
Software management and integration: Oversee the management of software accounts, including budgeting and tracking costs to ensure optimal use of resources. Ensure the effective integration of these tools, creating a seamless workflow that enhances productivity and aligns with the organisation’s strategic objectives.
Data accuracy, quality control and data security: Oversee data collection processes, implement quality control measures, and ensure robust data security protocols are in place to protect sensitive information and prevent unauthorized access.
Collaboration with M&E and repayments teams: Work closely with the M&E and repayments teams to ensure data supports their reporting, operational, and analytical needs, driving program improvements and operational efficiencies.
Data reporting and insights generation: Analyse and interpret data to generate insights that inform decision-making, strategic focus, new product development and provide clear, actionable reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Support data analysis projects: Design, develop, and run data models, statistical analyses, and visualisations that inform strategic, operational, and financial decision-making.
Support and lead process improvements: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for improving data collection, storage, and analysis processes, driving efficiency and effectiveness.
Develop and maintain a data retention and backup strategy: Establish a comprehensive strategy for data retention and backup that ensures compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements, safeguards data integrity, and minimizes the risk of data loss.
Documentation and compliance: Ensure that all data processes adhere to organizational compliance standards and best practices in data governance, maintaining comprehensive documentation of data protocols, systems, and workflows.
VALUES REQUIREMENTS
● Analytical and Insightful: Ability to interpret complex data and extract meaningful insights that drive informed decision-making.
● Detail-Oriented: Ensures accuracy and precision in data collection, modeling, and reporting to maintain data integrity.
● Collaborative: Works effectively with cross-functional teams, particularly M&E and repayments, to align data efforts with organizational goals.
● Solution-Oriented: Proactively identifies data-related challenges and develops solutions to improve processes and reporting.
● Accountable: Takes ownership of data protocols, quality control, and reporting, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of insights.
● Innovative: Continuously seeks opportunities to enhance data processes and systems, staying ahead of industry trends.
● Ethical and Compliant: Upholds high ethical standards in handling sensitive data, ensuring compliance with data governance practices.
QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE
● Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
● 5+ years of experience in data science, data analytics, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in developing data models, protocols, and warehousing systems. CRM management experience is beneficial.
● Proficiency in data analysis tools and languages: Strong experience with tools such as Python, R, SQL, Deluge and data visualization platforms.
● Experience with data warehousing and ETL processes: Proven track record in managing large datasets and building scalable data pipelines.
● Strong statistical and data modeling skills: Ability to design and implement predictive models, perform statistical analyses, and translate findings into actionable insights.
● Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, particularly with Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), finance, or operational teams, to align data strategies with organisational goals.
● Experience in compliance and data governance: Familiarity with data privacy regulations and best practices for ensuring compliance and ethical data handling.
● Excellent communication skills: Able to translate complex data insights into clear and concise reports for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
● Demonstrated problem-solving abilities: Proven ability to troubleshoot data-related issues and implement solutions that enhance data accuracy and efficiency.
INTERESTED?
Please email your CV (maximum two pages – applications exceeding this length will not be reviewed) along with your reasons for wanting to be considered for the role. Include your motivation in the body of the email and send your application to Leana at work@wafunda.com

Who is Quantium?
Quantium is a world leader in data science and artificial intelligence. Established in Australia in 2002, Quantium is a global team of more than 1,200 people across 14 locations with a unique blend of capabilities across product and consulting services to help businesses unlock value from data and analytics. Quantium partners with the world's largest corporations to forge a better, more intelligent world.
About Quantium Health
Quantium Health is a joint venture between Discovery Health and Quantium. We specialise in healthcare-focused data science, working across health insurance, hospitals, pharmaceuticals, MedTech and retail pharmacies. Our distinctive approach combines clinical understanding with advanced analytics, and we’re proud to be Anthropic's global enterprise partner for generative AI implementation in healthcare.
Our work transforms the way healthcare organisations operate. We have conducted retrospective real-world studies to compare long-term health outcomes in hypertension, partnered with governments worldwide to optimise their COVID-19 vaccine rollouts, and developed the Vitality AI platform which enables hyperpersonalised, real-time recommendations powered by machine learning.
How will you make an impact?
Analytics leadership: Lead analytical delivery for healthcare clients, ensuring consistent high-quality solutions that address complex data challenges and drive tangible business outcomes
Team development: Manage and mentor a technical team of analysts, developing their technical capabilities and fostering professional growth through coaching and knowledge sharing
Stakeholder engagement: Maintain strong relationships across all levels of client organisations, from subject matter experts to C-suite executives, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and business objectives
Strategic communication: Translate technical concepts and analytical insights into accessible recommendations for non-technical audiences through compelling presentations and communications
Technical excellence: Leverage advanced SQL, cloud platforms and data visualisation tools to deliver complex data processing and dashboard creation for healthcare sector requirements
AI innovation: Apply understanding of generative AI applications to enhance analytical productivity and deliverable quality, staying current with emerging technologies
Culture building: Contribute to maintaining Quantium's culture and collaborative environment within the Johannesburg office through visible leadership and team engagement
The Superpowers You'll Be Bringing To The Team
Technical proficiency: 7+ years' experience in advanced analytics / data science, with 1-2+ years in a leadership or mentoring capacity
Advanced technical skills: Strong Python / SQL proficiency for complex data querying and manipulation across large datasets
Cloud expertise: Experience with large-scale data processing and familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, Databricks)
Academic background: Degree in a relevant field such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, economics or related discipline

Consultative approach: Experience building trusted relationships with stakeholders and gaining in-depth understanding of their objectives to develop relevant solutions that solve complex problems
AI understanding: Understanding of generative AI applications in analytics and consulting contexts
Healthcare interest: Healthcare sector experience or strong familiarity with healthcare data challenges and regulatory requirements is highly desirable
Remember – you might not tick all the boxes, but don't let that stop you from applying. We're more interested in how you work, your ability to solve problems and think big.

Working at Quantium will allow you to challenge your imagination. You will get to solve complex problems using rigour, precision and by asking great questions – but it also means you can think big, outside the box and push your problem-solving skills to the max.

Find your kind: Embrace diversity and connect with like-minded colleagues in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment
Make an impact: Leave your mark by contributing to projects that drive positive change across the health sector

Continuous learning: Our vision is empowering our people to thrive. The Analytics Community fosters the development of individuals, thought leadership and technical excellence at Quantium through building strong connections, fostering collaboration and co-creation of best practice

descriptions.title: Applications Solutions Architect
descriptions.description:
DVT is one of the top software engineering companies on the African continent. Our consultants work alongside some of the most established architects and engineers in South Africa — embedded within leading organisations across mining, financial services, and industrial sectors — applying the latest cloud and AI technologies to deliver measurable business value.
We are seeking a senior Applications Solutions Architect to join our cloud practice, embedded within a large Gauteng-based mining group. This is a strategic technical consulting role — not a cloud engineering or DevOps position. The successful candidate will serve as the design authority for application and cloud architecture across the client's IM Mining Applications portfolio.
Critically, this individual will deploy and operate DVT's Cloud Contour framework as a managed client-facing service — an AI-powered cloud advisory platform that provides continuous cost optimisation, architecture governance, and cloud health insights. The ability to translate Cloud Contour outputs into executive-ready recommendations and client-facing roadmaps is a core deliverable of this role.
The ideal candidate is a seasoned architect with strong technical depth, excellent stakeholder communication skills, and the ability to lead design activities across complex integration landscapes — including mining operational technology (OT) and enterprise application ecosystems.
Duties And Responsibilities
Architecture & Solution Design
Lead solution design activities for business demands, translating requirements into scalable, governed technical architectures aligned to client IM standards
Act as Design Authority during execution and delivery phases — reviewing, approving, and guiding technical decisions across delivery teams and vendors
Design and maintain reference architectures for application and cloud-based infrastructure across the client's mining applications portfolio
Identify and address architectural risks, technical debt, and integration gaps across Source Systems and data reporting layers
Produce high-quality technical artefacts including High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and Solution Design Documents (SDDs)
DVT Cloud Contour — Service Delivery
Deploy, configure, and operate the DVT Cloud Contour framework within the client's Azure and/or AWS environment as a managed advisory service
Produce regular Cloud Contour reports covering cloud cost optimisation opportunities, architecture compliance, security posture, and infrastructure health
Translate Cloud Contour AI-generated insights into prioritised client recommendations, executive summaries, and governance-ready roadmaps
Drive adoption of Cloud Contour outputs by facilitating monthly architecture review sessions with client IM leadership
Act as the primary DVT point of contact for Cloud Contour service queries and enhancements at the client site
Integration & System Architecture
Design integration patterns between source systems (mining operational technology, ERP, SCADA) and data reporting and analytics layers
Define and govern API standards, data contracts, and system integration specifications across the application landscape
Collaborate with infrastructure, data, and application delivery teams to ensure end-to-end architectural coherence
Support the evaluation and selection of integration tooling, middleware, and cloud-native services appropriate to the mining environment

Own and facilitate the creation of all technical documentation required for Service Introduction and operational handover
Maintain an up-to-date architecture repository and ensure artefacts are version-controlled and peer-reviewed
Provide technical governance oversight — ensuring deliverables conform to IM architectural principles and DVT quality standards
Support project planning and resourcing activities from a technical architecture perspective
Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory
Serve as the primary technical interface between DVT, client business stakeholders, vendor partners, and infrastructure delivery teams
Lead or support vendor-led sprints and delivery phases, providing architecture oversight and decision-making authority
Present architecture proposals, findings, and Cloud Contour insights to senior client stakeholders including CTO, CIO, and IM leadership
Mentor and guide client technical staff on architecture best practices, cloud adoption patterns, and Cloud Contour tooling
Knowledge And Skills
Technical
7–12 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or Cloud Architecture roles with a strong focus on application integration and cloud-native design
Demonstrated experience acting as a Design Authority or Architecture Lead on complex multi-vendor, multi-system programmes
Strong technical background in cloud-based infrastructure architecture across Azure and/or AWS
Solid experience with system integration patterns — REST APIs, event-driven architecture, ETL pipelines, and middleware platforms
Proficiency in producing architecture artefacts to professional standards: HLD, LLD, ADR, SDD, and operational handover documentation
Experience deploying, managing, or consuming AI-powered advisory or FinOps tooling (e.g. CloudHealth, Apptio Cloudability, or equivalent — DVT Cloud Contour training will be provided)
Ability to translate technical architecture findings into commercial recommendations and executive presentations
Understanding of mining operational technology (OT) environments, SCADA systems, or industrial data platforms is highly advantageous
Strong stakeholder management skills — comfortable engaging CTO, CIO, and business leadership audiences
Excellent written and verbal communication with strong technical documentation capability
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to architectural design
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and the architecture's role within iterative delivery programmes
Preferred Qualifications
Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) — Strongly preferred
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02) — Strongly preferred
TOGAF 9 or 10 Certification — Beneficial
Experience in mining, resources, or heavy industry sector environments
Exposure to FinOps practices, cloud cost governance, and cloud advisory platforms
Experience with data architecture, data lakehouse patterns, or BI reporting layers
Familiarity with enterprise integration platforms (Azure Integration Services, MuleSoft, TIBCO, or equivalent)
MINIMUM EDUCATION
Matric (Grade 12) certificate
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent proven experience in Solution Architecture)
At least one cloud architecture certification (Azure AZ-305, AWS SAA-C03, or TOGAF) — Required
Minimum 7 years' experience in a Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or Cloud Architecture role
Ability to work on-site in hybrid model at client offices in Rosebank, Johannesburg
DVT CLOUD CONTOUR
Opportunity to be trained on DVT Cloud Contour is an AI-powered cloud advisory platform built by DVT Cloud Solutions. It provides continuous, automated analysis of a client's cloud environment — delivering real-time insights across cost optimisation, architecture compliance, security posture, and infrastructure health.
Cloud Contour enables organisations to move from reactive cloud management to proactive governance — surfacing optimisation opportunities, compliance gaps, and architectural risks before they become operational issues.
The Applications Solutions Architect in this role will be trained on and certified in Cloud Contour, and will be responsible for operating it as a live client service — producing monthly advisory outputs and facilitating governance reviews with the client's IM leadership team.

Analysis and Design: You will examine documentation like business requirements and specifications. This review helps you derive appropriate test estimates and formulate a strategic test approach, ensuring thorough test coverage.

descriptions.title: Data Engineer
descriptions.description:
Who We Are
Yoco was founded in 2015, and we’ve been breaking down barriers, unlocking economic opportunities and opening commerce for people to thrive ever since.
We’re the payments provider for over 200,000 self-employed, and process over US$3 billion annually.
We have ±350 team members globally, all with a bias for boldness and a passion for simple, progressive solutions. We believe in uniting different people to solve hard problems, together.
Our mission of making society more equal requires a variety of people, with different backgrounds and points of view, to keep building solutions that make life easier for emerging businesses.
We’re growing fast. With growth comes compelling challenges. If you’re an ambitious problem-solver, with big ideas, a passion for doing good, bright, grounded and courageous; you’re likely to thrive at Yoco.
We don’t stop pushing. We break things to rebuild. We challenge ourselves and each other. We’re constantly evolving - and we’re doing it fast.
Grow With Us.
About The Data Engineering Team
The primary function of our Data Engineering team is to develop, operate, and enhance scalable, cloud-based frameworks, platforms and infrastructure.
About The Role
As a core member of the broader Engineering team, the Data Engineer will work closely with our Engineering and dedicated Data team to build the backbone of our data ecosystem. In this role, you won't just be building isolated pipelines; you will be helping us evolve a unified, massive-scale solution. You’ll be responsible for the full data lifecycle—ingress, egress, and complex transformations—using batch, real-time, and hybrid processing models to deliver high-value data products.
What You Will Be Doing
Build & Scale: Develop high-quality, maintainable, and performant source code and configurations for our cloud-based data processing frameworks.
Architectural Implementation: Work within defined architectural patterns to build scalable data platforms with a focus on sophisticated orchestration and real-time event processing.
Collaborate: Work cross-functionally with stakeholders to ensure timely, relevant deliverables and seamless integration with other engineering arms.
Technical Delivery: Own the lifecycle of your deliverables. You don’t just build; you plan, execute, and troubleshoot. You’ll be responsible for navigating project hurdles by highlighting risks or dependencies proactively.
Innovate: Engage in a culture of experimentation and collaborative problem-solving to overcome complex data challenges and improve operational efficiency.
About You
Experience: 2–4 years of dedicated Data Engineering experience in a professional environment.
Cloud Proficiency: Hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms, specifically GCP and/or AWS.
Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing. You should feel comfortable writing clean, testable code.
Modern Data Stack: Demonstrated experience implementing components of the modern data stack (e.g., dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, or Kafka).
Software Mindset: A good understanding of modern software engineering practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD, and unit testing.
Adaptability: The ability to deal with complexity and ambiguity to deliver high-quality data products in a fast-paced environment, acting proactively to identify architectural and operational improvements.
Good communication skills: The ability to communicate effectively with teammates and across functional areas within the business, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution. This includes documentation and managing hybrid working arrangements.
Operate & Monitor: Contribute to the reliability and observability of key data pipelines, including monitoring, alerting, and participating in incident response to ensure data availability and quality.
Bonus Skills
While experience using modern data stacks is required, hands-on production experience with any of the following will set you apart:
Containerization & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with IaC(Terraform), Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing infrastructure and portable data microservices.
Workflow Management: Proficiency with Apache Airflow for designing, scheduling, and monitoring complex programmatic workflows.
Real-time Streaming: Familiarity with Confluent Kafka for building event-driven architectures and managing high-throughput data streams.
Modern Transformation: Experience using dbt (data build tool) to manage the "T" in ELT, applying software engineering best practices (like version control and testing) to SQL.
Other Data Engineering tools: Experience using other industry standard tools like Debezium and dltHub
AI-Assisted Development: Experience leveraging AI-powered code generation and productivity tools to streamline development workflows and accelerate delivery.
Be lekker
The people we’re looking for
We’re looking for people who want to grow and have a thirst for learning. And as Yoco grows, we hope they stay with us for the long-term.
Building solutions for a more equal society is a daunting task - and it’s not for everyone. We never stop pushing, we break things to rebuild, and we challenge ourselves and our teammates. We start over, we constantly evolve - and we do it fast. We know that it’s just the right kind of meaningful madness for our kind of visionary human.
So, who are you? You’re someone who resonates with our mission and our values, and you’re relentlessly effective in your execution.
You’re a curious problem-solver with a passion for doing good. You’re bright, grounded, experimental and bold. You play open cards and get stuck in. You’re not afraid of change. You close the loop.
At Yoco, we laugh, embrace each other’s quirks, and support one another’s growth, all while staying authentic.
If this sounds like your kind of challenge, apply below and come grow with us.
We encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply and ask that you please send your application in English and help us reduce unconscious bias by leaving out your picture, age, address, and other unnecessary information in your CV.
We believe that the best work comes from a place of balance and security. We see our benefits not as perks, but as a partnership to support your life, your family, and your ambitions.
Need time to switch off? We offer 24 paid leave days annually, plus public holidays, so you can rest, travel, or simply handle life.
Thinking about long-term security? We'll help you build a strong foundation with contributions to medical aid and gap cover.
Putting your family first? So do we. We provide paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents, along with family responsibility leave for unexpected emergencies.
Ready to grow your skills? We provide an annual learning budget for you to invest in the courses, conferences, or training that will help you advance your career.
Looking for your community? Find it here. From weekly company gatherings and team outings to employee-led clubs, we foster a connected culture where everyone belongs.
Yoco is the all-in-one digital commerce platform for small businesses.
As one of Africa’s largest fintech companies, we make it easy to sell anywhere, manage your business from anywhere, and grow with smart insights—all under one Yoco profile.
Founded in 2015, we've helped over 200,000 small businesses across South Africa accept card payments and access capital—often for the first time.
Our ecosystem of payments, software, and tools works seamlessly under one Yoco account. Behind it all is a global team of 350+ people across South Africa and the Netherlands, building world-class solutions for small business growth.

Structured with step-by-step instructions

descriptions.description:
Let's Write Africa's Story Together!
Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.
Job Description
Role Purpose:
An exciting opportunity exists for two experienced Risk Governance & Reporting Managers to strengthen and support the Group Risk function at Old Mutual Limited (OML).
The purpose of this role is to contribute specialist expertise to the design, enablement, and ongoing improvement of enterprise‑wide risk governance and reporting practices across the Group. The role supports the consistent, proportionate, and defensible application of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks, methodologies, policies, systems, and reporting, ensuring that risk management enables effective decision‑making rather than compliance‑driven execution.
The role plays a key part in ensuring that risk governance frameworks, risk information, and risk insights are aligned to regulatory expectations, risk appetite, and Board requirements, and remain fit‑for‑purpose in a complex and evolving business environment.
Role Overview:
The Risk Governance & Reporting Officers will operate at the centre of the Group’s Integration & Governance (I&G) function within OML Group Risk.
Working in a Line 2 environment, the role provides exposure to enterprise‑wide risk governance architecture, senior stakeholders, and Board‑level governance processes. The role operates across all I&G focus areas, spanning the development and application of risk governance frameworks and standards, the evolution and consistent application of ERM methodology, the delivery of Group‑level risk reporting and insights, the effective use of risk systems and data, and the enablement of strong risk understanding and capability across the organisation, including support for relevant training and awareness initiatives.
The role is ideally suited to professionals with strong risk governance experience who can operate with high judgement, independence, and credibility at Group level.
Key Result Areas / Outputs
The Risk Governance & Reporting Manager will work closely with Risk Partners, Line 1 stakeholders, policy owners, subject matter experts (SMEs), and the broader Risk and Assurance community to enable consistent, high‑quality risk governance and reporting outcomes across the Group.
Acting as a Group‑level governance and reporting specialist within Group Risk (Line 2), the role provides independent oversight, technical guidance, and constructive challenge to ensure that risk governance practices, methodologies, systems, and reporting outputs are clear, consistently applied, decision‑useful, and aligned to regulatory expectations, risk appetite, and Board requirements.
The role plays a critical part in delivering Board‑ready risk reporting, defensible governance artefacts, and forward‑looking risk insight that supports effective executive and Board‑level decision‑making across the Group.
Key Responsibilities (KRAs)
Enable and maintain the Group ERM framework and risk governance standards, ensuring alignment with the Group Governance Framework (GGF), regulatory expectations, and risk appetite.
Support the consistent and proportional application of ERM methodology across the Group, including risk assessment approaches, risk matrices, KRIs, and aggregation practices.
Promote consistent interpretation of inherent and residual risk assessments, supporting comparability, aggregation, and credible enterprise‑wide risk views.
Support custodianship of the Group Risk Policy Framework, including governance standards, rollout, ongoing monitoring, and policy attestation processes.
Partner with Line 1 policy owners and SMEs to enable effective adoption of risk governance requirements, providing guidance and oversight while maintaining Line 2 independence.
Deliver and enhance Group‑wide risk reporting and insights for executive and Board‑level forums, incorporating trends, drivers, appetite performance, and emerging risks.
Support the effective use and ongoing improvement of ERM systems and risk data, contributing to system configuration alignment, data quality, reporting enablement, and analytical capability.
Contribute to the enablement of strong risk understanding and capability across the organisation, including the development and facilitation of relevant training, guidance, and awareness initiatives.
Act as a trusted Line 2 governance partner, providing guidance, insight, constructive challenge, and defensible input into regulatory and governance engagements.
Qualifications, Skills and Experience:
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree required in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Law, or a related discipline.
Professional risk or governance qualification advantageous (e.g. IRMSA, CA(SA), CFA, FRM, or equivalent).
Ongoing professional development in enterprise risk management or corporate governance preferred.
Experience:
7+ years’ experience in enterprise risk management, risk governance, or second‑line risk oversight within a complex organisation (preferably financial services).
Demonstrated experience supporting or contributing to Group‑level risk governance frameworks, ERM methodology, and policy governance.
Proven experience in executive and/or Board‑level risk reporting, including aggregation, trend analysis, and decision‑useful insight.
Practical exposure to risk appetite frameworks, inherent and residual risk assessment, KRIs, and enterprise risk aggregation.
Experience working in a Line 2 environment, providing independent oversight, guidance, and constructive challenge.
Familiarity with recognised frameworks such as ISO 31000 and COSO ERM.
Experience working with the ERM system, CURA, to support risk assessment, reporting, aggregation, and data quality is advantageous.
Leadership:
Leads through influence, credibility, and subject‑matter authority rather than formal people management.
Demonstrates sound judgement and confidence when engaging senior stakeholders, executives, and governance forums.
Acts as a trusted governance partner, balancing collaboration with independent challenge and integrity of Line 2 oversight.
Comfortable operating in a broad, integrated role, flexing across governance, methodology, and reporting priorities.

descriptions.title: Legal Head II
descriptions.description:
Job Description
Hello Future Legal Head II
Welcome to FNB Personal Customer Segments, the home of the #Changeables. We design for the shapeshifters and deliver products and services that make us incredibly proud with people who make it happen.
As a Legal Head, you will join a team where experts come together to ignite effective change. We call these #changeables our nav-igators – people who want to use tech to help others nav-igate their lives and businesses. As nav-igators, we are made up of unique talents, diverse minds, adaptability, and we live up to the promise of staying curious.
Join a dynamic, fast-paced in-house legal team supporting PCS and PSS within the Personal Segment. As Legal Head, you are the senior legal business partner to the Business Unit Stratco/Exco/ManCo and functional leadership, providing expert legal advice, hands-on contracting and negotiation support, and strong leadership of legal risk management. The role is accountable for formulating and implementing a Legal Risk strategy and framework aligned to business strategy, regulatory obligations and Group governance standards.
Role purpose
Provide pragmatic, business-enabling legal advice to PCS and PSS, while proactively identifying, managing and reporting legal risk. Drive a high-performing legal service culture, strengthen third-party and outsourcing legal oversight, and embed privacy, data, and AI governance controls appropriate.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic leadership & stakeholder partnering
Act as a trusted legal advisor to PCS and PSS leadership; provide clear, commercially sound guidance aligned to strategy and risk appetite.
Build and manage objective working relationships with external attorneys, Group Legal Services and FRG Legal Services to obtain specialist opinions where needed.
Establish, align and manage targets and budgets for the legal function, ensuring effective cost control and value delivery.
Translate complex legal and regulatory requirements into clear business actions, playbooks, and decision-ready advice.
Proactively identify emerging legal issues affecting products, channels, partnerships, and customer outcomes;
Legal risk management & governance
Formulate and maintain the Legal Risk strategy and operating model for PCS and PSS, including governance forums, escalation pathways and decision rights.
Benchmark current practices against the legal risk management framework; identify and communicate current and emerging legal risks; recommend and implement mitigations.
harmonising legal risk with operational risk, conduct and regulatory compliance reporting for Exco/board-ready decisioning.
Own legal risk reporting: monthly risk reporting, quarterly audit/risk/compliance reporting, and ad-hoc executive and regulator-ready reporting.
Contracting, third-party & outsourcing oversight
Draft, review, update and negotiate agreements (customer-facing, supplier, technology, and strategic partnerships) to manage legal risk.
Ensure contracts align with procurement and outsourcing governance (including SLAs, performance measures, audit rights, confidentiality, and data processing terms).
Implement contract standards, clause libraries, playbooks, and approval matrices to reduce cycle time and manage risk consistently.
Conduct spot audits of key supplier contracts and SLAs, and drive remediation where contract or SLA performance issues arise.
Privacy, data, conduct & AI governance
Provide privacy law guidance (POPIA, GDPR where applicable) and practical privacy risk management support to PCS and PSS teams.
Partner with business stakeholders to manage legal risk from AI-enabled capabilities (e.g., knowledge tools, speech analytics, automated QA), including data protection, IP, vendor risk and documentation obligations.
People leadership & capability building
Plan and manage performance, skills development, talent and culture within the legal team to deliver high-quality outcomes and continuous improvement.
Embed a service culture that builds rewarding relationships, encourages innovation and enables teams to deliver exceptional client service.
Lead, coach and develop the legal team; drive performance management, skills development, and talent retention.
Ensure effective resourcing and succession planning, and support transformation, equity, and inclusion objectives.
Experience & Qualifications
You'll be an ideal candidate if you have:
Minimum qualification of a BA Law Honours (NQF Level 8)?
Admitted attorney with at least 6-8 years’ post-qualification experience (preference for financial services experience).
Proven track record in drafting and negotiating complex contracts in a corporate or financial services environment (specialist expertise).
Deep understanding of privacy legislation (POPIA, GDPR, etc.) and practical experience in privacy risk management (preferred).
Experience in legal risk management, regulatory interpretation, and providing business-focused legal advice.
Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and thrive in a high-volume, high-impact environment.
Adaptability/learning agility – to be comfortable with ambiguity, context-switching, and taking on a mix of work within the PSAS space.
Technological proficiency (preferred).
You Will Have Access To
Opportunities to network, collaborate and work across Segments and teams
Challenging work environment
Opportunities to innovate and add value to team, leadership and business effectiveness.
We Can Be a Match If You Are
Curious & courageous - you're driven by always wanting to know more and learn more and you're brave enough.
Obsessed with mastery - you know what it takes to become good at what you do and are constantly pushing yourself to do it
You are open to ongoing personal mastery & development.
Are you interested to take the step? We look forward to engaging with you further. Apply now!

descriptions.title: Managed Services Operations Specialist
descriptions.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
Your day at NTT DATA
The Managed Services Operations Specialist works closely with colleagues from all Services divisions to manage all aspects of service delivery into the various service delivery contracts within their client(s) and ensure the continued focus on the execution of the agreed service plans and initiatives. The Client Services Operations Manager ensures the integrity of the services provided by the Dimension Data Group. The primary responsibility of the Managed Services Operations Specialist is to plan, manage and monitor the implementation of operational activities and processes in order to deliver on approved operational plans and to continuously enhance service delivery. These individuals contribute to the definition and management of the Services Delivery strategy and execution thereof into their clients.
They hold subject matter knowledge spanning Infrastructure and/or Application aligned to the Dimension Data Group Go-To-Market Practices
Enterprise IT Governance
Reviews current and proposed information systems for compliance with the organisation's obligations (including legislation, regulatory, contractual and agreed standards/policies) and adherence to overall strategy. Provides specialist advice to those accountable for governance to correct compliance issues.
Service level management
Ensures that service delivery meets agreed service levels. Creates and maintains a catalogue of available services. In consultation with the client negotiates service level requirements and agrees service levels. Diagnoses service delivery problems and initiates actions to maintain or improve levels of service. Establishes and maintains operational methods, procedures and facilities in assigned area of responsibility and reviews them regularly for effectiveness and efficiency.
Relationship management
Implements stakeholder engagement/communications plan. Deals with problems and issues, managing resolutions, corrective actions, lessons learned and the collection and dissemination of relevant information. Collects and uses feedback from Clients and stakeholders to help measure effectiveness of stakeholder management. Helps develop and enhance Client and stakeholder relationships.
Client service support
Responsible for day-to-day management, resource planning and work allocation to meet agreed service levels. Specifies, agrees and applies standards. Ensures that tracking and monitoring of performance of service delivery through all channels (human, digital, self-service, automated) is carried out, metrics and reports are analysed, and issues are resolved. Drafts and maintains policy, standards and procedures for the Client service or service desk functions. Ensures that the catalogue of requestable and supported services is complete and current.
Work Outputs
Manage the Service Delivery process.
The Managed Services Operations Specialist assists in defining, developing and communicating the service delivery operations process and procedures. They contribute to the identification of opportunities for optimal efficiency and drive continual improvements into the delivery process and procedure. This individual contributes to and participates in all initiatives to drive service improvement in order to gain optimal efficiency. They will assist in ensuring that the operational model for service operations is well defined, structured and continuously improved to deliver cost effective, client centric services that meet service level agreements to the service contracts.
Manage strategy implementation.
The Managed Services Operations Specialist provides input into the development of the tactical strategy and develops and implements a supporting operational strategy. These individuals will recommend best practice for the deployment and ongoing operations management and technical support for service contracts. They understand and interpret business climate and precedent and advise the business on the application to improve company competitiveness. They will work with other NTT Data service divisions to build best practice services for our clients. They take responsibility for the management of services for strategic business change and ensure that services are aligned to the client’s business requirements. They will contribute to the development and implementation of a service management and delivery strategy for the services business.
Transition of service contracts
Working with the Transition Management teams this role is part of the transition of service contracts into the NTT Data operation. They ensure that the right skills are deployed and adherence to all standards, processes, policies and work instructions as determined by global services organisation.
Set financial targets.
They analyse operational records, trends and costs related to estimated and realised revenues to project future revenues and expenses. Managed Services Operations Specialist establishes financial targets for individuals and teams and identify opportunities to minimise cost or increase sales/revenue.
Manage stakeholder relationships.
They develop and maintain productive working relationships with peers and organisational role players to achieve optimal cross process integration.
Ensure client satisfaction.
They act as a bridge between the clients and the technical organisation providing sound consulting services and recommendations based on Client and client needs, current information and trends. In so doing, they review, analyse and make recommendations on improvement opportunities in each service lifecycle phase.
This role will act as the point of escalation for delivery teams for client satisfaction issues. This individual will be responsible for understanding the core issues affecting the client and will work with the relevant service teams to resolve. This role will also work with the relevant teams to monitor client satisfaction and contractual compliance for our clients.
Ensure operational efficiency.
The Managed Services Operations Specialist ensures the development, alignment and implementation of end-to-end processes, leading to operational, process, quality, standard and service optimisation. He/she assists in the timeous identification and solving of operational problems. They implement and use governance, compliance procedures and processes effectively to identify and manage risks and expose previously unknown liabilities. These individuals implement, manage and report on cost improvement objectives and communicate or escalate any shortfalls.
They ensure the provision of accurate and timeous reporting and related insights in respect of key performance metrics and recommendations to improve operational efficiency. He/she develops and maintains operational procedural manuals, including preparing and distributing of appropriate updates. They implement people resource planning in line with delivery and performance objectives, budget and in partnership with specialised areas.
Work Experience Required.
8 years experience in service delivery within a large-scale technology services environment across a range of services including outsourced services.
Extensive experience in managed services and service delivery environment including technical and service management exposure.
Track record of effective workshop facilitation and interviewing skills
Solid management and leadership experience
Possess working knowledge of ITIL with preference to executing in the environment.
Demonstrate a broad understanding of the vast range of IT operations and Dimension Data service offerings.
Possess knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.
Possess a strong business and commercial orientation with a supporting interest in technology.
Demonstrate skills in persuasion and influencing management, staff, suppliers, clients and vendors.
Possess excellent presentation and communications skills and comfort with communicating solutions to clients at a business and technical level.
Demonstrate a strong client and quality orientation.
Strong sense of urgency and accountability.
Broad technical understanding of key Infrastructure and Security components.
Seasoned work experience in Managed Services delivery within a large scale (preferably multi-national) technology services environment.
Seasoned experience gained in a service delivery environment including technical and service management exposure.
Seasoned experience in managing customer escalation situations and objection handling.
Seasoned Managed Services operations experience.
Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
Information Technology Certificate or equivalent in Information Technology or Business Administration or related.
ITIL foundation certification.
Key Responsibilities:
Dashboards all key Metrics and manages the about to be breached situations.
Ensures that services are meet the stated service level agreement (SLA) levels.
Ensures that the operational deliverables enable cost effective, client centric delivery that meets SLAs.
Monitors the operational effectiveness of support services and develops and implements the required improvement plans.
Balances the needs of the client with the strategic direction of the organization.
Understands the core issues affecting the client and works with the relevant service teams to resolve.
Identifies needs, risks and issues and proposes appropriate solutions and courses of action.
Provides input to Operations Managers and Service Managers during client reviews (for example, report on service volumes and metrics).
Performs any other advanced operational tasks as required by leadership.
Knowledge and Attributes:
Excellent customer service focus.
Excellent communication skills and ability to prepare structured, and relevant communications to operations leaders.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work in a fast paced and deadline driven environment.
Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment.
Seasoned ability to quickly become proficient in delivery processes and related systems.
Excellent ability to analyze, design and improve operations processes.
Excellent focus on business outcomes.
Ability to work across different cultures and social groups.
Ability to work well in a pressurized environment and adapt to changing circumstances.
Workplace type:
On-site Working
About NTT DATA
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an @nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

descriptions.title: AI / Automation / MI Specialist at Datonomy Solutions
descriptions.description:
The mandate of this role is to unlock the full value of this debt recovery platform by embedding AI-enabled automation and real-time reporting capabilities.
To transform the Debt Collection & Recovery reporting function from a reactive, spreadsheet-based monthly reporting model to a real-time, AI-driven self-service insight environment.
This role is not about maintaining reporting — it is about fundamentally redesigning how operational performance is measured, accessed, and used to drive recovery outcomes.
Key Focus Areas Within Debt Recovery Context
Collections Performance Automation
Automate real-time tracking of:
Recovery rates o Roll rates o Cure rates o Promise-to-pay adherence o Collector productivity
Build dynamic dashboards for:
Team leaders o Operations managers o Executive oversight
Portfolio Intelligence
Create AI-enabled segmentation views:
Risk bands o Delinquency buckets o Legal vs pre-legal accounts
Develop predictive insights around:
Likelihood of recovery o Optimal contact strategies o Early intervention triggers
Self-Service Reporting
Move From
“Please send me last month's pack”
To
“Click a few buttons and view live portfolio performance”
Enable
Drill-down from portfolio level ? team ? individual collector ? account
Automated daily/weekly performance views
Exception reporting
Automated alerts for KPI deviations
Operational Workflow Optimisation
Automate reporting tied to:
Case allocation o Call queues o Settlement approvals o Legal escalation
Reduce manual reconciliations between operational teams and MI reporting.
Core Responsibilities
AI & Automation
Leverage Jonas Software's debt collection modules to build automated reporting layers.
Identify embedded AI features within the platform and optimise their usage.
Design intelligent performance triggers (e.g., auto-flags for underperforming segments).
Integrate reporting outputs into BI tools where required.
Data Architecture & Integration
Map the data structures within the debt recovery system.
Ensure correct data extraction from:
Debtor master data o Transaction logs o Call activity records o Payment histories
Work with IT to enable API-driven or database-driven integrations.
Reporting Disruption
Decommission redundant spreadsheet-based reporting.
Standardise definitions for:
Recovery rate o Roll rate o Cost-to-collect o Net collections
Embed governance around KPI ownership.
Change & Adoption
Upskill operational managers to use real-time dashboards.
Redefine management meeting structures around live reporting.
Reduce reporting preparation time across the function
The Bank's Debt Collection & Recovery Function Operates Within a Specialist Vertical Solution Provided By Jonas Software. This Platform Is Purpose-built For
End-to-end debt collection lifecycle management
Case management and account tracking
Payment arrangement monitoring
Performance tracking of collectors and teams
Recovery strategy optimisation
Commission and incentive tracking
Regulatory and compliance reporting
Operational workflow management
While the system enables structured data capture and AI-driven capabilities, the business is still heavily reliant on:
Manual Excel-based monthly MI packs
Static reports
Offline reconciliations
Delayed performance insights
Required Experience
Strong experience within:
Banking collections o Debt recovery operations o Credit lifecycle environments
Experience transforming operational reporting functions.
Hands-on experience with collections systems (advantage).
Proven automation of MI in high-volume operational environments.
Experience shifting business users away from Excel dependency.
Desired Skills
AI Specialist
Automation Specialist
Management Information Specialist

descriptions.title: Global Business Tactical Financial & Planning Capacity Analyst (Manager Individual Contributor capacity)
descriptions.description:
Summary of the role:
Supports planning and execution across lines of business. The role converts demand signals, service due dates, and constraints into weekly capacity settings, partner guidance, and actionable plans for Dispatch and Field leadership to protect customer commitments while managing spend.
Functional Responsibilities:
Due Date & Capacity Management (Tactical Horizon)
Manage due date performance in PACE and recommend actions to protect customer commitments.
Adjust repair and order capacity settings for the upcoming week and in‑month as intake/backlog shifts.
Review escalated time‑off requests and coordinate approvals/mitigations with Field Managers (FM).
Monitor intake and backlog trends; identify emerging constraints and propose tactical levers (e.g., pressurization, rebalancing).
Weekly Resource Plan, Handoffs & Field Touchpoints
Build and document the weekly tactical resource plan, including capacity assumptions, constraints, and recommended actions.
Handoff next week’s plan to Dispatch Managers (weekly handoff) and align on execution expectations.
Run/participate in field touchpoints to review NADD/due dates, changes, and plan adjustments.
Review “out of load” technicians and advise Field Managers on hours required / rebalancing options.
Workforce Optimization Levers (Tech Placement, Service Areas, Dual‑Skilled Strategy)
Ensure RGU/slot availability for key products through active capacity and slot management.
Implement tactical pressurization levers (e.g., blue/yellow/red) by region—relocate technicians, shift dual‑skilled resources, and mitigate bottlenecks.
Review and adjust service areas to reduce travel and place technicians in the highest‑demand areas.
Develop execution plans to shift dual‑trained technicians to where demand is highest; monitor outcomes and refine weekly.
Partner Capacity, Spend Governance & Invoice Validation
Adjust partner hours based on order + repair intake and backlog; maintain partner guidance for dispatch execution.
Review and adjust partner efficiency assumptions; reflect changes in capacity and forecasting models.
Reporting, Interlocks
Deliver ad‑hoc reporting and analysis to support day‑to‑day operational decisions.
Prepare and present materials for WOR/operations reviews, sales updates, and strategic interlocks
Technical Skillset Required
Strong analytical skills and high proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (models, pivots, scenario analysis).
Comfort working with planning/operations systems (e.g., PACE, SRM, workforce scheduling or ticketing tools).
Ability to build clear reporting and presentations for operations and leadership audiences.
Experience translating operational intake/backlog into capacity settings and execution plans.
Non-Technical Skills:
Structured problem solving and sound judgment under time pressure (incident/disaster scenarios).
Attention to detail, ownership, and bias to action.
Strong communication and stakeholder management across Dispatch, Field, Partners, and Leadership.

At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.
Role Overview
The Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for maintaining high editorial standards across course materials by reviewing written and multimedia content for accuracy, clarity, consistency, and accessibility. This role applies defined quality standards and style guides to ensure materials are polished, compliant, and ready for publication. You will work closely with the Lead Quality Assurance Analyst and relevant teams to resolve issues efficiently and meet delivery timelines.

Edit and proofread course materials to a consistently high standard across written content, video scripts or on-screen text, graphics copy, and other learner-facing assets
Review accessibility copy, including alt text and supporting descriptions, to ensure clarity, accuracy, and alignment with accessibility guidelines
Apply agreed quality standards, style guides, and brand guidelines across all assigned materials
Check grammar, punctuation, syntax, spelling, and tone consistency, and ensure content reads clearly for the intended audience
Review referencing and academic integrity requirements and flag issues for correction or escalation
Identify, log, and track quality issues using agreed workflows and tools, ensuring a clear audit trail
Coordinate with the Lead Quality Assurance Analyst and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve content quality issues and clarify standards
Manage and prioritise multiple QA tasks across projects while meeting tight deadlines
Communicate progress, risks, and blockers clearly and timeously to the Lead Quality Assurance Analyst
Contribute feedback that strengthens QA processes, checklists, and documentation to improve consistency over time
Requirements
Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in English, Linguistics, Education, or a closely related field
Fluent English with professional-level writing and editing capability
Demonstrated experience of at least 5 years in editing, proofreading, or editorial quality control
Demonstrated experience applying style guides and maintaining consistent editorial standards across multiple content types
Strong attention to detail with the ability to spot errors and inconsistencies across text and multimedia elements
Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet strict deadlines
Strong organisational skills and dependable time management
Clear written communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback to stakeholders
Comfort working with digital content and collaborating across teams
Experience in online education environments is advantageous
Familiarity with tools such as ClickUp, Google Workspace, Wistia, Frame.io, H5P, or Canvas is advantageous
Benefits
Collaborative, people-centred performance culture
Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment
Work that supports high-quality learning experiences through editorial excellence
A role that values precision, accountability, and constructive collaboration
Our Recruitment Process
The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.
Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
Video Interview Stage: You'll be invited to record short responses to 3-4 role-specific questions.
Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you'll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.
Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

descriptions.title: Business Analyst
descriptions.description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."
Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively
We are looking for a Business Analyst with extensive expertise in retail operations who understands the core functionalities a modern ERP system must offer to meet retailers’ demands. Today’s retailers need more than basic transaction handling—they require ERP solutions that support real-time inventory visibility, customer loyalty programmes, pricing and promotions management, analytics, and omni-channel fulfilment. This role will be critical in ensuring that Klipboard’s ERP solutions address the unique and diverse needs of retail businesses, providing tools that enable operational agility, efficiency, and an optimised customer experience.
As the Retail Subject Matter Expert (SME), you will take a lead role in analysing and designing solutions that go beyond surface-level requirements. You’ll apply in-depth retail knowledge to identify and implement ERP features that enhance store performance, improve inventory accuracy, streamline customer engagement, and support profitable, data-driven decision-making across all retail channels.
Key Responsibilities
Retail ERP Expertise: Act as the primary authority on essential ERP functions for retail, encompassing EPOS (Electronic Point of Sale) management, real-time inventory tracking, cycle counts, stock receipts, customer loyalty integration, and multi-store support. Your strategic input will ensure Klipboard’s ERP products address the high-performance demands of modern retail environments.
Advanced Inventory and Stock Management: Drive the design and optimisation of features that support real-time inventory visibility, dynamic stock control, and accurate cycle counting. You’ll play a central role in developing capabilities that enable retailers to monitor stock levels across multiple locations, manage shrinkage, and automate reordering to prevent stockouts or overstocks.
Promotions and Pricing Management: Analyse and define ERP capabilities that allow retailers to manage complex promotions, discounts, and dynamic pricing strategies. You’ll develop solutions that enable retailers to adjust pricing quickly in response to demand or to run tailored promotions that enhance customer engagement and sales.
Customer Loyalty and Personalisation: Collaborate on features that integrate loyalty programmes and CRM functionality within the ERP, helping retailers foster customer loyalty and personalise the shopping experience. You’ll ensure systems capture and analyse customer data to enable targeted marketing and reward loyal customers effectively.
Omni-Channel Fulfilment and Order Management: Define requirements for robust order management and omni-channel fulfilment, allowing retailers to handle orders from various channels (in-store, online, mobile) with seamless efficiency. You’ll work on solutions that enable “click and collect,” ship-from-store, and returns handling, ensuring a unified customer experience across all sales channels.
Data Analysis and Reporting: Develop ERP functionalities that support real-time sales reporting, performance analytics, and customer insights. You’ll specify tools that allow retailers to track KPIs such as sales per square foot, product turnover, and customer retention, enabling data-driven decision-making and trend analysis.
Multi-Store and Franchise Support: Design features to enable multi-store management for franchise or chain operations, providing centralised control over pricing, inventory, promotions, and customer data. You’ll help create solutions that support consistent operations across multiple locations, while allowing local customisation where needed.
Process Analysis and Improvement: Conduct detailed assessments of retail workflows to identify opportunities for ERP enhancements. You’ll recommend optimisations that streamline transaction handling, improve checkout speed, enable flexible pricing adjustments, and enhance the customer experience both in-store and online.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Scrum Teams to ensure retail requirements are translated effectively into ERP features. You’ll act as a bridge between retail business needs and technical execution, ensuring alignment across departments to deliver solutions that maximise operational and customer-focused outcomes.
User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Lead UAT efforts, working with retail stakeholders to test ERP functionalities thoroughly. You’ll design real-world scenarios that reflect complex retail environments, ensuring new features meet retailers’ needs in EPOS, inventory management, and customer engagement before deployment.
Skills, Knowledge And Experience
Skills and Competencies
Retail and ERP Systems Expertise: Extensive knowledge of retail ERP systems, covering functionalities like EPOS, inventory and stock control, promotions management, customer loyalty programmes, omni-channel fulfilment, and CRM. Your expertise will guide the development of ERP solutions that are efficient, scalable, and aligned with retailers' operational needs.
Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills: Strong analytical abilities, with the capability to interpret complex retail data and identify practical ERP solutions that address common pain points, such as stock accuracy, customer retention, and transaction speed.
Communication and Influence: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ERP functionalities into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Agile and Product Development: Experience in Agile environments, allowing you to work effectively within fast-paced, iterative development cycles and adjust to evolving requirements within the retail landscape.
Process Modelling: Skilled in mapping retail workflows, ensuring ERP solutions are designed to support end-to-end retail processes, from in-store transactions to customer loyalty management and data-driven decision-making.
Qualifications
Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business management, Retail Operations, or a related field. Advanced qualifications in retail, ERP, or inventory management are highly beneficial.
Professional Experience: Minimum of 5 years in a business analysis role focused on retail ERP functionalities, with significant experience in EPOS, inventory control, promotions, and CRM systems. Experience in omni-channel retail operations is advantageous.
Certifications: Business Analysis certifications (CBAP, PMI-PBA) and retail ERP-related certifications are advantageous, reinforcing your expertise in best practices and industry standards.
Key Behaviours and Attributes
Strategic Mindset: Proactive and solution-focused, with an ability to see the larger business impact of process improvements. You’re a big-picture thinker who can translate high-level strategies into actionable steps.
Collaboration and Teamwork: Naturally collaborative, you’ll engage openly with cross-functional teams, fostering a constructive and high-performing working environment. Your approach to feedback and knowledge-sharing will be essential in building trust and cohesion across departments.
Commitment to Professional Growth: A strong dedication to continuous learning and improvement, keeping up with industry trends and advancing personal expertise to drive excellence in the O2C space.
Company Info
You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Business Analyst (Talent Pool)

Our fast-paced and dynamic environment enables smart, self-driven people to be their best. Discovery Vitality RSA Systems is a dynamic and energetic environment which encourages an ownership attitude. The environment provides innovative systems development, architecture, support and infrastructure to our internal clients. This environment thrives on customer engagement and customer experience as well as mutually beneficial relationships with our business units and other key stakeholders. It is important for our employees to provide a world class service to our internal and external clients, thereby ensuring long and sustainable relationships.
Key Purpose
Understanding the business requirements and through a structured process documenting, validating and translating it into functional specifications that are used by developers to craft a technical solution. Testing and validating the functionality of the technical solution against the business requirements. Interfacing between the business client and the development team with regards to the business and functional requirements. Ensuring that the business requirements are delivered in the implemented solution. Working with multiple business areas and multiple teams that require deep integration of solutions. Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and acting as a consultant on the application.
Areas Of Responsibility May Include But Not Limited To
Act as a consultant to the client on the application
Participate in client planning forums and advise on solutions
Challenge the business in their thinking, especially to understand the intent of the business requirement
Assist business to articulate the benefits they wish to realize with the solution
Pursue enquiries with clients to understand the "why" rather than the "what" of the business request
Facilitating the development of a Business Case
Customer Requirements Specification (CRS)
Follow a structured process to listen to, understand and document client requirements If needed, facilitate activities like interviews or JAD sessions to expand the understanding of the business requirements
If required, perform analytical tasks, data extracts, run queries or any other form of analysis to gather information
Following up with clients to clear up ambiguity and possible misunderstanding
Documenting the requirements in a Customer Requirements Specifications (CRS) document (which may include UML models, business process documents)
Ensuring alignment between the Business Case and the CRS
Review the functional requirements with the client, using appropriate formats such as presentations and walk-through discussions and obtain sign-off on CRS
Product Requirements Specification (PRS)
Design and validate the functional solution
This involves interpreting the CRS into a set of Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS)
Apply knowledge of the system, interfaces and dependencies to highlight integration aspects that must be considered
Identify a set of stakeholders that need to be involved in creating and validating the PRS
Interview business and technical owners, as well as experienced members of the development team (Development Manager, Architect, Business Analyst Senior)
Identify and Involve other teams and domains that must be integrated to for the solution to work
Build & demonstrate GUI prototypes, to validate the designs
Perform modelling & build data models that simulate the solution
Identify and design a set of test cases/scripts, test scenario's and test data sets to accompany the PRS
Validate the PRS and Test Basket with the client and identified stakeholders and obtain sign-off
Solution Proposal:
Review the approved CRS and PRS with the development team
If required, revert back to client or other stakeholders if technical issues require business decisions in order to proceed
Answer queries from the development team on business or functional aspects of the required solution
Defend the client business requirements
Project Documentation
