Linux RedHat.
Understanding Linux troubleshooting and permission SELinux.
Ansible & Prometheus.
Storage technologies - block, object.
Integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
Troubleshooting experience.
Solid Cloud (Azure) experience (hybrid Cloud).
Programming fundamentals in any language.
Customer support experience (customer needs are top priority).

Senior Hybrid Azure Cloud Engineer
Hybrid Azure Cloud Engineer
Azure Cloud Engineer

About the position
We are looking for a Senior Resident Engineer (with 15 or more years experience in construction supervision or management) to join a leading consulting engineering firm on a large scale civil and mining construction project in Limpopo.
The expected contract duration is 30 months.
The role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, sound communication skills to manage a diverse group of stakeholders, rigorous focus on quality control, solution driven attitude and hands-on site supervision to ensure works are delivered safely, regulatory compliant, and to specification.
The successful candidate will manage the engineer’s quality control site team, coordinate various contractors, facilitate compliance with health, safety and environmental regulations and ensure that all works align with the Engineer’s project specifications and the company objectives.
Requirements:
Degree or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or Building Technology.
Minimum of 15 years’ experience in construction supervision, monitoring or management.
Professional registration with ECSA or SACPCMP.
Proven track record in monitoring greenfield or brownfield mine development or large civil infrastructure projects.
Extensive experience in construction quality assurance processes and systems.
Understanding of standard form construction contracts like NEC, FIDIC, GCC, etc.
Experience in earthworks, concrete structures, structural steel, pump and pipeline, as well as mechanical, electrical and instrumentation installation coordination.
Previous exposure to projects regulated by the Mine Health and Safety Act 29 of 1996 and Regulations
Valid SA driver’s license is mandatory.
Key Responsibilities:
Ability to lead and manage a team of resident engineers, assistants and other site staff responsible for quality assurance, design verification, environmental control, etc.
Coordinate resources and facilitate efficient stakeholder communication.
Liaise with the design team based in our office to ensure any design deviations are clearly identified, recoded and communicated, and that the appropriate action recommended by the designers is implemented.
Manage all on-site construction supervision activities.
Ensure compliance with approved designs, specifications, contracts, and statutory requirements.
Review and give input to the contractor’s Quality Control Plan, ensuring that activities and milestones align with the project’s design intent and minimum requirements stated by the design engineer.
Enforce QMS and QA/QC procedures.
Ensure that RFIs, TQs, material approvals, shop drawings, and method statements are reviewed and responded to in consultation with designers.
Ensure that materials and workmanship are inspected and all testing results are reviewed and approved.
Manage and record all non-conformances and deviations through to close-out.
Assist the consultant’s contracts manager with relevant contract administration activities.
Monitor contractor performance against programmes and milestones.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
Maintain up to date and accurate site records, correspondence, and variations throughout the project.
Attend and document site and stakeholder meetings.
Ensure the team of resident engineers give input on work completed for interim payment certificates and verify that quantities claimed align with progress achieved.
Support commissioning, snagging, and final handover.
Manage the project close-out process, including facilitation of data pack collation, redline drawing mark-ups and contribute to as-built documentation.

construction management
resident engineer
mining
infrastructure

descriptions.description:

About the position
Background:
Wits Health Consortium (Pty) Limited ("WHC") is a wholly-owned Company of the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg (South Africa) under its Faculty of Health Sciences
WHC provides Faculty with a legal framework within which to operate the research and other activities necessary to support its academic objectives
In addition, WHC offers a range of products and services to Academics
Main purpose of the job:
To provide high-quality clinical care and conduct protocol-specified procedures for trial participants while supporting laboratory functions on site, ensuring participant safety, specimen integrity, accurate documentation, and compliant conduct of study visits in accordance with GCP and study protocols
Location:
SYNPASE Research Clinic, Edendale Lay Ecumencial Center Clinic, Edendale, Pietermaritzburg
Key performance areas:
1. Participant Clinical Care & Safety
Conduct all study-related clinical procedures in accordance with the protocol, SOPs, and GCP
Perform participant assessments including medical history, symptom screening, vitals, pregnancy testing, and targeted physical exams where delegated
Monitor participant safety, identify and manage adverse events, and escalate concerns to the Research Clinician/PI as required
2. Study Visit Implementation
Prepare for and conduct participant study visits (screening, enrolment, follow-up, safety visits) according to protocol timelines
Ensure informed consent/assent is obtained and documented correctly for all participants (and caregivers where applicable
3. Specimen Collection & Laboratory Procedures
Collect biological specimens (e.g., blood, swabs, urine, sputum) in accordance with study protocols, GCP, and infection prevention standards
Perform protocol-specific specimen processing procedures, including centrifugation, aliquoting, labelling, and temporary storage, within required timelines to maintain sample integrity
Verify participant identifiers and ensure accurate specimen labelling to prevent misidentification or cross-contamination
Maintain proper chain-of-custody documentation from point of collection through processing and transfer or shipment
Ensure specimens are stored under appropriate temperature-controlled conditions and that temperature logs are completed and reviewed
Complete and reconcile laboratory logs, requisition forms, source documents, and electronic tracking systems accurately and in real time
Prepare and package specimens for shipment in accordance with protocol requirements, sponsor specifications, and applicable shipping regulations
Identify, document, and promptly report specimen-related deviations, discrepancies, or equipment malfunctions to the study lead or laboratory supervisor
Support laboratory readiness for monitoring visits, audits, and sponsor inspections by maintaining organised and up-to-date documentation
4. Data Quality & Documentation
Complete all source documents, CRFs, and electronic data entries (MACRO/REDCap or other EDC platforms) accurately and in real time
Maintain organised participant files and study documentation (digital and hard-copy) in accordance with sponsor and WHC requirements
Respond to and resolve data queries in collaboration with data management team
5. Communication & Team Collaboration
Maintain professional, supportive interactions with participants to promote retention, safety, and adherence
Communicate clinical management issues and participant safety concerns promptly to the Study Coordinator and Principal Investigator
Attend regular study meetings, trainings, and debriefs
Support onboarding and mentoring of junior or newly assigned trial staff where relevant
Required minimum education and training:
Grade 12
Diploma in Nursing or Bachelor’s Degree in Nursing required
Qualified as a Professional Nurse
Fluent in English and Isi-Zulu
HIV Management and Counselling course will be advantageous
Human Subjection Protection Certificate will be advantageous
TRREE (Training and Resources in Research Ethics Evaluation) will be advantageous
Good Clinical Practice Certificate will be an advantageous
Experience with Electronic data systems (e.g RedCap) and Excel will be advantageous
Knowledge of ALCOA + Principles
Knowledge of Informed Consent Process
Driver’s licence and able to drive manual vehicle
Professional Body Registration:
Registered with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse
Required minimum work experience:
2-4 years’ experience in an a clinical trial setting
1-2 years’ experience in a research laboratory environment
Experience in NIMART or ART clinic will be advantageous
Ability to draw and process blood samples
Desirable additional education, work experience and personal abilities:
Proficient in a range of laboratory processing procedures
Familiarity with lab equipment calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting
Understanding of quality control, assurance processes, and temperature controlled storage of specimens
Experience with stock management
Good communication skills - for working with clinical staff, patients, and research coordinators

About the position
To work as part of a team executing the systems engineering on projects covering design, development, construction, integration, verification and commissioning of complicated systems, elements, subsystems and associated supporting
infrastructure and operational systems, both in the facilities in Cape Town and on site at Carnarvon in the Northern Cape.
JOB DESCRIPTION
Ensuring delivered systems meet stakeholder needs through executing requirements engineering by defining, analysing and managing requirements, establishing and maintaining traceability and developing system and sub-system design-to specifications
Converting stakeholder needs and requirements into physical engineered systems through executing functional and physical architecting, analysis and synthesis, identifying and creating ICDs, performance analysis, performing FMECAs to implement safety in design and generating performance, build-to and maintain to specifications
Deliver systems with verified performance and quality through implementing ICDs, physically assembling items, preparing and executing Verification Plans, Test instructions, ATPs and QTPs, ATRs and QTRs and establishing and maintaining baselines (DBL, QBL,PBL, OsBL)
Ensuring the delivered systems continue to operate and deliver the expected performance by maintaining the PBS in ALIM, managing baseline changes via ECPs, CNs, waivers, concessions, , performing Root Cause Analysis and designing modifications to eliminate failure modes.
JOB REQUIREMENTS
Qualification:
Tech (Eng) with 6+ years RELEVANT experience; OR
Eng/B.Sc (Eng) with 4+ years RELEVANT experience; OR
Eng/M.Sc (Eng) with 3+ years RELEVANT experience; OR
PhD/D.Eng with 1+ years RELEVANT experience,
AND
Must be eligible to register as PrEng/PrEng Tech with ECSA
Experience:
A background in development of systems in radio astronomy, radar, satellite or avionics systems is preferred.
Physical, hands-on experience in integration, test and verification of complicated systems which includes RF, digital and mechanical elements.
Applied Systems Engineering across the multiple lifecycle stages of a system or product, at all levels up to user systems (L5) of the systems hierarchy.
Model-Based Systems Engineering and the use of Computer-aided Systems Engineering Tools (e.g. CORE/GENESYS)
Application and control of systems engineering processes and procedures.
Baseline establishment and management.
Engineering Change control
Knowledge
:
Recognised domain knowledge of systems engineering, technology and/or software, based on theoretical aspects and experience in systems engineering methods, procedures, tools and techniques.
Integration, test and verification of complex systems
Baseline establishment and engineering change control
Configuration management and configuration management systems.
Application of Systems Engineering Standards, e.g. ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288 & 15289, along with the associated processes and procedures
Quality assurance systems (ISO 9001)
Knowledge of the PFMA and related procurement regulations

communications
engineering
projects
fault diagnostics

descriptions.title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptions.description:
Reference: DBN000858-AD-9
Our client, based in Durban, is looking for a strategic and architectural level Engineering Specialist in this newly created role.
The main purpose of this role is to build from scratch their big data/bioinformatics solutions (including all hardware and software aspects). This will be a senior management role with decision-making responsibility. A key aspect of this role will be to define the strategy and then to design and roll out the entire infrastructure.
This role will suit someone from a Scientific institution or a university that has worked with scientific research solutions.
They have a implemented a hybrid working model with 2 days in the office and 3 days at home. You can also be based either in Durban OR in Somkhele (Richards Bay area).
You will be required to design, plan, setup, configure, support high performance data pipelines for scientific compute resources, working closely with the science team. The science team will have the science experience but not the technical experience and they are looking to bridge that gap. This person will sit within the IT team and provide assistance to the science departments.
Likely candidates will have past experience working at universities or other research and science related institutions, or some larger corporate type roles that do similar data heavy computation work.
They will be skilled in many niche technical aspects including databases, but this is not just a DBA only role.
They must be skilled on the technical side of building the data pipelines which may involve Cloud and/or hardware and software skills and knowledge.

Duties & Responsibilities

This role is for a Senior Data Engineer with AI Experience to help build and maintain scalable data pipelines and related systems in a research focused environment. You will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying technical platforms and data solutions that meet the business requirements and align with the scientific goals. You will collaborate with research scientists, internal IT and other stakeholders to ensure data quality, reliability, accessibility, security and governance. This is technical role (not just a DBA or Data management role) that needs a high degree of core IT technical background and skills
Design, develop, and maintain the end-to-end technical aspects (hardware - on prem and/or cloud) of a high performance compute and storage platform designed specifically for data pipelines in a research data intensive environment
Design, develop, and maintain the end-to-end data pipelines (software, DBs and processes) required to support the research scientists and data managers.
Support ETL processes including, data ingestion, transformation, validation, and integration processes using various tools and frameworks
Optimize data performance, scalability, and security
Provide technical guidance and support to data analysts and research scientists.
Design data integrations and data quality frameworks
Work and collaborate with the rest of the IT department to help develop the strategy for long term scientific Big Data platform architecture
Document and effectively communicate data engineering processes and solutions.
Make use of and help define the right cutting edge technology, processes and tools needed to drive technology within our science and research data management departments.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Industry recognized IT related certification and technology qualification such as Databases and Data related certifications.
This is a technical role so a strong focus needs to be on technical skills and experience
Minimum Experience:
7+ years’ experience in a Data Engineering, High Performance Computing, Data Warehousing, Big Data Processing
Must have AI experience
Strong experience with technologies such as Hadoop, Kafka, Nifi or Spark or Cloud-based big data processing environments like Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery and Azure Synapse Analytics
At least 5 years’ advanced experience and very strong proficiency in UNIX, Linux, Windows Operating systems and preferably containerization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes etc
Working knowledge of various data related programming, scripting or data engineering tools such as Python, R, Julia, T-SQL, PowerShell, etc.
Strong working experience with software compute and virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, OpenStack, KVM etc.
Strong working experience with hardware compute platforms including high performance compute cluster hardware and related technologies.
Knowledge and Abilities:
Strong Experience working with various relational database technologies like MS SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL as well as NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, Cassandra etc.
Experience of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark and Hive
Experience with data pipeline tools such as Airflow, Spark, Kafka, or Dataflow
Experience working with containerization is advantageous
Experience with data quality and testing tools such as Great Expectations, dbt, or DataGrip is advantageous
Experience working with Big Data Cloud based (AWS, Azure etc) technologies is advantageous
Experience with data warehouse and data lake technologies such as BigQuery, Redshift, or Snowflake advantageous
Strong Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines including the compute hardware infrastructure.
Strong knowledge of data modeling, architecture, and governance principles
Strong Linux Administration skills
Programming skills in various languages advantageous
Strong data security and compliancy experience
Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills
Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
Interest and enthusiasm for medical scientific research and its applications
SUMMARY:
There is large emphasis on the technical element in the role (having experience working with and designing hardware clusters from the ground up). They have a number of technical skills and experience already within the IT department but are looking for someone very strong, and with the past working experience, to help design these clusters and understand the technology in play for advanced scientific computational requirements.
This goes beyond just the hardware element though and you will need strong Linux, Data Pipeline and coding/scripting skills. Although this is not a developer role, you should be comfortable with a certain level of coding/scripting and data analysis packages with strong virtualization skills like VMware, HyperV, OpenStack, KVM etc.
You will therefore be that technical link with the scientists and will help build platforms (could be hardware, software, cloud etc) and then also manage the Data and Data Pipelines on this system. This would include the compliancy, performance and security of the data too.

Monthly plus Medical Aid, Pension

The position of
Business Process Analyst
is vacant. The Business Process Analyst will report directly to the Business Process Manager and forms part of the Office of the Chief Operations Officer Division. The position is based at GEMS Head Office in
Pretoria
.
The total remuneration package will be

closing date
for applications will be
Wednesday, 25 March 2026
.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Business Process Analyst will be required to provide support to the Business Process Manager through the implementation of the following Key Performance Areas (KPAs):
Process Mapping & Documentation: Facilitate process mapping sessions and document “As-Is” and “To-Be” processes using standard BPM methodologies and tools. Ensure detailed, accurate, and maintainable process artifacts.
Business Requirements Gathering: Engage stakeholders to collect, validate, and document business requirements that will inform process optimisation or system enhancements.
Process Analysis & Optimisation: Analyse process performance, identify inefficiencies or gaps, and propose data-driven improvement recommendations aligned with strategic and operational goals.
Support Process Standardisation & Quality: Ensure consistent application of process standards and contribute to quality assurance by validating that process improvements follow BPM best practices and governance.
System Integration Awareness: Understand how business processes interact with ICT systems. Work collaboratively with ICT and business teams to ensure that process improvements are technically feasible and aligned to system capabilities.
Transformation & Change Enablement: Support the transition from the current (“As-Is”) to the future (“To-Be”) operating model by providing process insights, documentation, and change readiness support across affected areas.
Governance, Compliance & Framework Alignment: Ensure all process work aligns to the Business Optimisation Office’s BPM framework, governance standards, and audit/compliance requirements, track adherence (process audits) and escalate gaps.

Degree/Professional qualifications at NQF Level 6 in Information Technology, Business Management or Analysis or similar.

descriptions.title: Full-Stack Delphi Developer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

We are looking for a practical, hands-on Delphi developer who can step into active projects. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working across the full stack of Delphi applications, including front-end UI, back-end logic, database design, and REST API integration.
This role requires a solid understanding of networking fundamentals, local vs hosted environments, and the ability to design, consume, and manage REST API endpoints. The developer will work primarily with Delphi (VCL/FMX) and Firebird SQL, building reliable, maintainable desktop and service-based applications.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Delphi applications (front-end and back-end logic)
Build user interfaces using Delphi VCL and/or FMX frameworks
Develop and maintain backend logic for desktop applications and related services
Design, create, and maintain databases using Firebird SQL
Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries, stored procedures, and database structures
Create and manage RESTful API endpoints using Delphi components, services, or frameworks
Consume RESTful APIs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and integrate responses into application business logic
Develop and maintain robust CRUD-based systems with proper validation, data integrity checks, and error handling
Troubleshoot and resolve application, database, and network-related issues
Ensure clean, maintainable, and well-structured code aligned with best practices
Apply working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including local vs global networks, IP addressing, port configuration, and connectivity between applications, databases, and services

Desired Experience & Qualification

Completed tertiary qualification in Computer Science or related field - preffered
4–5 years’ experience in Delphi development (junior candidates with strong additional technical skills will be considered)
Strong working knowledge of Delphi, including desktop application development using VCL and/or FMX
Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs in Delphi
Solid understanding of CRUD-based systems (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
4–5 years’ SQL experience with strong relational database design skills
Practical experience with Firebird SQL, including table design, queries, and stored procedures (Microsoft SQL Server advantageous)
Exposure to the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
Understanding of networking fundamentals (local vs public IPs, port usage, basic firewall and router configuration)
Ability to work within an existing system architecture and extend functionality without compromising stability
Ability to perform under pressure in a deadline-driven environment
Web development experience (PHP, Ajax, jQuery) would be advantageous
Soft Skills
• Able to quickly understand existing Delphi codebases and database structures.
• Strong problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills and ability to follow specifications.
• Able to work independently and manage tasks effectively.
• Willingness to learn and adapt to existing systems and workflows

Package & Remuneration

We offer a competitive salary package, which will be discussed with shortlisted candidates during the interview stage.

Location

Job Description
The Performance Tester is responsible for designing, developing, and executing performance testing scripts to ensure the reliability, scalability, and responsiveness of banking and finance applications. This role involves analysing system behaviour under varying workloads, identifying bottlenecks, and providing detailed reports with actionable insights to support continuous improvement of application performance.
The successful candidate works closely with development, quality assurance, and infrastructure teams to define performance testing requirements, develop test plans, and validate system performance against agreed service levels. The role requires a thorough understanding of performance testing tools and methodologies within a regulated financial environment, ensuring compliance with internal policies and industry standards.
Job Duties
Non-functional testing of pipelines/ LMS endpoints
Develop and maintain performance test scripts based on functional and non-functional requirements.
Plan and execute performance, load, stress, and endurance tests on banking and finance applications.
Analyse test results to identify performance issues, bottlenecks, and areas for optimisation.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define performance criteria and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Prepare detailed reports and documentation on test findings, including recommendations for improvement.
Monitor system behaviour during testing to detect anomalies and potential failure points.
Ensure all performance testing activities comply with regulatory and organisational standards.
Support the implementation of performance monitoring tools in production environments.
Continuously research and apply best practises and emerging trends in performance testing.
Assist in the training and mentoring of junior testers on performance testing techniques and tools.
Required Qualifications
Relevant tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Professional certification in software testing or performance testing is advantageous.
Education
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
Experience
Minimum of three years’ experience in performance testing within the banking and finance sector or a similarly regulated environment.
Proven experience with performance testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, or equivalent.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute comprehensive performance test plans and scripts.
Experience analysing complex system behaviours and interpreting test results accurately.
Exposure to agile software development methodologies and continuous integration practises.
Knowledge and Skills
Jmeter, performance analysis.
Strong understanding of software development life cycle and testing methodologies.
In-depth knowledge of performance testing concepts including load, stress, spike, and endurance testing.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Java, JavaScript, or similar for test script development.
Ability to interpret system architecture and database structures to design effective performance tests.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey technical findings clearly.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Familiarity with monitoring tools and application performance management solutions.
Working Conditions
The role is based in Johannesburg and requires adherence to standard full-time working hours, with occasional flexibility to support testing activities outside normal business hours. The position involves working primarily in an office environment with the possibility of remote work as required. The Performance Tester may be required to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic banking and finance setting.

Performance Tester

.

.

descriptions.title: Junior Data Engineer
descriptions.description:
Job Purpose
The purpose of the Data Engineer is to leverage their data expertise and data related technologies, in line with the Nedbank Data Architecture Roadmap, to advance technical thought leadership for the Enterprise, deliver fit for purpose data products, and support data initiatives. In addition, Data Engineers enhance the data infrastructure of the bank to enable advanced analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence by providing clean, usable data to stakeholders. They also create data pipelines, Ingestion, provisioning, streaming, self service, API and solutions around big data that support the Bank's strategy to become a data driven organisation.
Job Responsibilities
Responsible for the day to day maintenance of data pipelines, providing support to the data squads including performing data related tasks (such as data profiling, data cleaning, data configurations, data support, data validation, data quality assurance) in a Data Epic and assisting in basic data pipelines, data ingestion and supporting Data Engineers in their Epics.
Data Infrastructure: Support and maintain the Data Infrastructure to ensure it is secure, available and reliable.
Data Pipeline Build (Ingestion, Provisioning, Streaming and API): Maintain data pipelines starting with Data Virtualisation, then progressing to Data Ingestion and finally to Data Provisioning. Ensure that data pipelines are monitored and run successfully and configure and support minor changes in data pipelines.
Data Visualisation: Create virtual data bases and assist in creating data extracts for the business in response to business needs.
Documentation and Data Analysis: Collaborate with the Data Analyst to perform data profiling, data validation, and data documentation in support of Epics.
Nedbank Data Warehouse Monitoring and Support: Monitor data pipelines and infrastructure to provide first line support, resolve issues and ensure that the warehouse meets its SLA timelines for data availability and warehouse reliability.
Nedbank Cloud Monitoring and Support Services: Ensure cloud processes (Compute and Storage) are monitored and managed daily, to ensure that Cloud pipelines run successfully.
Operations: Support and run daily operational reports to ensure that all jobs ran successfully and that the data warehouse is maintained according to standard.
Collaboration: Work collaboratively with business stakeholders to gain business knowledge, understand data extracts and improve and optimise business queries.
Essential Qualifications - NQF Level
Matric / Grade 12 / National Senior Certificate
Advanced Diplomas/National 1st Degrees
Preferred Certifications
Cloud (Azure, AWS), DEVOPS or Data engineering certification.
Any Data Science certification will be an added advantage, Coursera, Udemy, SAS Data Scientist certification, Microsoft Data Scientist.
Minimum Experience Level
Total number of years of experience: 2 years Result-driven, analytical creative thinker with demonstrated innovative problem solving skills.
Self-motivated, proactive and organised with the demonstrated ability to handle-multiple and simultaneous tasks meeting aggressive deadlines.
Team player with demonstrated ability to stay calm and composed in the face of adversity.
Technical / Professional Knowledge
Cloud Data Engineering (Azure , AWS, Google)
Data Warehousing
Databases (PostgreSQL, MS SQL, IBM DB2)
Data Analysis and Data Modelling
Data Pipelines and ETL tools (Ab Initio, ADB, ADF, SAS ETL)
Agile Delivery
Please contact the Nedbank Recruiting Team at +27 860 555 566

descriptions.title: Senior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
descriptions.description:
Role: Senior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer
Industry: Advanced AI systems
Location: South Africa (Remote)
Employment Type: Full-time / Indefinite Contract
Introduction:
Our client (US-based) builds advanced AI systems that reason over complex data, documents, and knowledge graphs. Their platform combines machine learning, natural language systems, and graph-based reasoning to automate decision-making in document-intensive domains.
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer who is comfortable working deep in the stack, from modeling and experimentation to building production systems that integrate models, tools, and data pipelines.
This role is not focused on prompt engineering or simple API wrappers. We are looking for engineers who understand how models work, how to evaluate them rigorously, and how to integrate them into scalable production architectures.
About the Role:
As a senior member of the team, you will design and build machine learning and AI systems used in production.
You will work closely with platform engineers, data engineers, and infrastructure teams to create systems that reason over documents, structured data, and knowledge graphs.
You should be comfortable moving between model development, experimentation, and production system design.
This role is fully remote but candidates must be based in South Africa.
Responsibilities:
Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models, including feature engineering, model selection, and statistical validation.
Build production-grade Python systems for data processing, model training, and inference pipelines.
Develop natural language processing systems for document understanding, classification, extraction, and semantic retrieval.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including embedding strategies, indexing approaches, retrieval evaluation, and grounding techniques.
Develop agentic AI systems that coordinate models, tools, and multi-step reasoning workflows.
Work with large volumes of unstructured and semi-structured data, particularly document-centric datasets.
Collaborate with platform and infrastructure teams to deploy and operate ML systems in production environments.
Analyse model performance, investigate failure modes, and implement iterative improvements based on empirical results.
Contribute to architectural decisions around AI system design and data modeling
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Strong Python programming experience for machine learning and data systems.
Experience designing and training ML models rather than relying solely on hosted AI services.
Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including statistics, optimisation, and model evaluation.
Hands-on experience building NLP systems for tasks such as document extraction, classification, or semantic search.
Experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines and retrieval systems.
Experience building agent-based or tool-using AI systems, including patterns such as planner–executor workflows or multi-agent coordination.
Experience working with production data systems and real-world datasets, not just research environments.
Strong problem-solving ability and the ability to translate ambiguous problems into measurable systems.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j.
Experience with knowledge graphs, graph-based reasoning, or Graph-RAG architectures.
Experience deploying ML systems in cloud environments such as Azure or AWS.
Familiarity with MLOps practices, including containerization, model deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience working with document-heavy or compliance-oriented domains.
Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems.
What You'll Work On?
You will help build AI systems that:
reason across multiple documents and data sources
integrate knowledge graphs and semantic retrieval
coordinate multi-step AI workflows using tools and models
operate reliably in production environments
This is a hands-on role building real systems, not purely experimental research.
Why Join?
Our client is building a platform at the intersection of AI, knowledge graphs, and automated reasoning. You will work on technically challenging problems alongside a team focused on building production-grade AI systems.

The primary purpose of this role is to develop advanced analytics solutions, machine learning models, and scalable data tools that support Guardrisk Life’s strategic and client-facing analytics initiatives.
The role forms part of the Data Analytics Life team within the Guardrisk Life Structuring & Solutions division and focuses on unlocking business value through intelligent use of data. This includes building analytical frameworks, developing predictive models, and creating automated reporting and data solutions that enable better decision-making across the business.
The successful candidate will work closely with internal stakeholders and Guardrisk Life clients to identify analytics opportunities, solve complex business problems, and translate large datasets into clear, actionable insights.
The role requires strong technical capability in SQL, Python, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, along with an analytical mindset and the ability to operate independently in a dynamic and evolving environment.

The Data Analytics Life team supports Guardrisk Life’s Structuring & Solutions division by delivering advanced analytics, client insights, and scalable data tools across the organisation.
The team works closely with Portfolio Managers, Product Development, Pricing, and client organisations to unlock value from Guardrisk Life’s data ecosystem. Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify new analytics opportunities

descriptions.title: Data Scientist
descriptions.description:
About the Company
There’s something different about shopping at SPAR; we’ve created a culture of caring and community to ensure our customers have a consistently enjoyable shopping experience in a uniquely friendly and family-orientated store. Nothing means more to us than our customers and we believe in going the extra mile to give them the best products while saving them money.
In the 1960s, a group made up of 8 wholesalers was given exclusive rights to the SPAR name and brand and serviced 500 independent retailers. Through business acquisitions and organic growth, today the SPAR Group Ltd operates six SPAR distribution centres, a Build it distribution centre and a pharmaceutical distribution centre who supply goods and services to more than 2400 SPAR, Tops, Build it and pharmaceutical stores across Southern Africa.
About the Role
The data scientist is responsible for shaping SPAR’s data-driven pricing strategy. This includes translating commercial objectives into actionable pricing frameworks, optimising the use of pricing models and tools while ensuring alignment with category, merchandising and market positioning goals.
The role also involves recommending pricing policy frameworks tailored to each division, store format and customer profile. Through collaboration with cross-functional teams and the use of analytics, the analyst ensures that pricing decisions support customer value, competitiveness and profitability.
Key Performance Areas
Build, deploy and maintain predictive and prescriptive models for high-impact retail use cases such as pricing strategies, demand forecasting, price and promotion optimization, assortment planning, customer segmentation and lifetime value prediction.
Ensure pricing logic reflects elasticity, competitive positioning and customer value perception.
Analyse omnichannel customer journeys by combining online browsing, in-store purchases, app usage, loyalty data, and external signals (economic indicators, competitor activity) to uncover behavioural patterns and revenue opportunities.
Partner as part of merchandising with regional sales, marketing, supply chain, e-commerce teams to translate business questions into analytical frameworks and measurable experiments (A/B tests, causal inference, uplift modelling).
Own end-to-end model lifecycle from data exploration to deployment and validation and bias/fairness checking.
Create interpretable insights that influence decisions.
Identify and integrate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
Contribute to scalable data products, recommendation engines, dynamic pricing systems, real-time inventory alerts, anomaly detection.
Stay current with retail-specific advancements (causal ML for promotions, GenAI for assortment ideation, reinforcement learning for pricing).
Design, test and refine pricing strategies to meet revenue, margin and market share goals.
Ensure pricing logic reflects elasticity, competitive positioning and customer value perception.
Drive development of analytical methods and algorithms.
Act as the business owner of the pricing tool, managing strategic configurations and decision parameters.
Collaborate with the Pricing team to ensure data integrity and tool performance.
Conduct scenario & impact analysis through simulations based on competitor pricing, elasticity and promotional scenarios.
Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership based on the analysis from the simulations.
Lead pricing workshops and train category managers on pricing methodologies and tool usage to build organisation-wide pricing capability.
Advise category managers with pricing recommendations, e.g., for larger scale price changes.
Partner with the Pricing team to ensure reliable inputs/outputs; work with promotions and marketing teams to align promotional pricing with overall strategy.
Translate tool outputs into insights, track KPIs and recommend corrective actions to balance value perception and profitability.
Engage with SPAR retailers to drive adoption of central pricing recommendations; present findings and strategy recommendations to senior management and cross-functional teams.
Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Operations Research, Mathematics or related quantitative field.
3–7+ years in data science/analytics roles; retail, e-commerce, consumer goods, or FMCG experience
Strongly preferred (experience with POS, loyalty, or supply-chain data is a big plus).
Required Skills
Retail economics: price elasticity, cross-sell/upsell effects, basket analysis, markdown decay curves, assortment optimisation
Time-series forecasting
Customer analytics
Strategic thinking and commercial acumen
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication and stakeholder influencing skills.
Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Quality orientated and self-driven to achieve results.
Excellent storyteller: can turn complex models into simple, actionable business recommendations
Collaborative & thrives working with non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrates curiosity and proactivity by independently identifying opportunities and areas for improvement.
Comfortable with ambiguity in fast-moving retail environments (seasonality, promotions, supply disruptions)
Preferred Skills
Experience deploying models to production at scale
Familiarity with retail-specific software (SAP, PowerBI, MS Fabric etc.)
Knowledge of causal ML, reinforcement learning or GenAI applications in retail
Strong business acumen with the ability to estimate R-value impact and prioritise accordingly

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

descriptions.description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.
What We Do
The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.
About The Role
GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.
Although every project is unique, you might typically:
Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare)
Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn)
Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction
Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility
Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency
Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations)
Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches
Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods
Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.
How To Get Started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.
Requirements
You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
You have at least 5 years of hands-on data science experience with proven business impact
You have portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem-solving.
You are proficient in python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels).
You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.
You are proficient in SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis
You have experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases)
You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows
You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain)
Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge

descriptions.description:
About Us
Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/
About The Role
We are looking for a QA Engineer (manual-first, API-heavy) to keep a payments platform stable during frequent releases and occasional urgent hotfixes. We don't run strict sprint cycles, so you should be comfortable in a Kanban / continuous delivery setup: clarifying scope, building lightweight test coverage, and shipping fast without breaking critical payment routes.
You will focus on risk-based testing of payment flows, end-to-end API validation (including webhooks), and maintaining pragmatic regression/smoke checklists that balance speed and safety.
Key Responsibilities
Manual testing: validate new features, fixes, and hotfixes across Web UI + APIs.
Risk-based testing: define test scope based on financial / customer impact; call out residual risks.
API / E2E validation: test REST APIs, async flows, and webhooks using Postman/Newman (or equivalent).
Data validation: verify state transitions and side effects in PostgreSQL; understand idempotency and retries.
Regression ownership: maintain and continuously improve smoke + regression suites for critical payment routes.
Incident-to-tests: convert production incidents into new regression cases or monitoring checks.
Collaboration: work closely with engineers/PMs to clarify requirements, reproduce issues, and verify fixes.
Release reporting: provide concise QA notes per release (scope, result, risks, follow-ups).
Qualifications
3+ years in QA with strong manual testing fundamentals.
Strong API testing skills (Postman/Newman, curl, Swagger/OpenAPI).
Practical understanding of: auth vs capture, refunds, webhooks, idempotency, retries.
Basic SQL (PostgreSQL): ability to validate records, joins, state transitions.
Experience with logs/monitoring (Grafana, Kibana/ELK, Sentry or similar).
Comfortable in Kanban / no-sprints / fast-changing requirements.
Good English (written + spoken) for remote async work.
Nice to have
Experience with PSPs (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Braintree, Worldpay, etc.).
Experience with 3DS flows (frictionless vs challenge) and SCA constraints.
Familiarity with test automation frameworks (pytest, Playwright) and CI (ability to read/maintain existing checks is a plus).
Understanding of network tokenisation (DPAN / network tokens).
Location
Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.
Benefits
Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:
Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tzxGX4Uu7Ts_HCLFXESKLnKaaBfVCPf1f9AYZPrkjJM/preview?tab=t.0
Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!
Interview Process
After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:
Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
Final Interview (60 minutes)

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Design and develop AI‑driven solutions to address complex business challenges
Own the end‑to‑end data lifecycle — sourcing data, cleaning and preparing it, exploring patterns, and performing ad‑hoc analysis

descriptions.title: Solutions Architect - Data
descriptions.description:
Role Overview
We are seeking a Solutions Architect with deep expertise in data architecture and experience in banking or financial services. The role focuses on designing and governing end-to-end data solutions across analytics, operational systems, regulatory reporting, and enterprise platforms. The Solutions Architect ensures architectures are scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards.
This is a 6-month contract with a hybrid working model, engaging with multiple business units and technical teams to accelerate delivery of mission-critical data initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Data & Solution Architecture
Design conceptual, logical, and physical data architectures supporting banking operations, analytics, and regulatory reporting.
Define end-to-end data flows, including ingestion, storage, transformation, integration, and consumption.
Create architecture blueprints, pipeline designs, and integration patterns (streaming, batch, event-driven).
Ensure solutions meet non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
Platform & Cloud Enablement
Collaborate with platform teams to shape cloud/on-premise data platforms (data lakehouse, MDM, metadata catalog, streaming).
Guide engineers on ETL/ELT, distributed processing, schema evolution, and best practices.
Influence tooling selection and configuration for modern data frameworks.
Governance & Standards
Ensure data solutions comply with enterprise standards, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements (POPIA, AML/KYC).
Promote reusable data assets, golden sources, and standardized data models.
Participate in architecture reviews, design assurance, and governance forums.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Work with architects, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver coherent end-to-end solutions.
Act as a trusted advisor on data design and architecture decisions.
Innovation & Future-State Architecture
Contribute to defining target-state architecture focusing on modernization, simplification, and automation.
Advocate modern data concepts: data products, federated domain ownership, event-driven integration, open table formats (Parquet/Iceberg).
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend evolution paths.
Required Skills & Experience
Technical:
Strong experience in data modelling (conceptual, logical, physical) across relational, dimensional, and NoSQL paradigms.
Deep understanding of data engineering (SQL, Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow).
Expertise in cloud-based (AWS/Azure) and hybrid environments, data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
Familiarity with metadata/catalog tools, governance frameworks, and data quality tooling.
Knowledge of integration patterns: ETL/ELT, API-based, stream processing, microservices.
Experience designing high-volume, low-latency data architectures.
Soft Skills:
Excellent communication with technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to simplify complexity and explain technical concepts clearly.
Collaborative influencer across federated teams.
Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving and architectural discipline.
Key Outcomes
Delivery of scalable, high-quality data architectures across business units.
Improved performance, reliability, and resilience of data pipelines and platforms.
Increased standardization and reduced duplication of data solutions.
Strong alignment between data, information, and solution architectures.
Compliance with governance and regulatory requirements with traceable lineage.
Enhanced accessibility of trusted, well-structured data for business analytics and reporting.
Application Notice
Should you not receive any feedback within three (3) weeks of submitting your application, please consider your application unsuccessful.

descriptions.title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptions.description:
Data Engineer
About the Role
We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join a collaborative data team where data engineering, analytics, and data science work side‑by‑side. Each Data Engineer works in a dedicated squad with a Data Scientist and a Data Analyst, building high‑quality data warehouses and pipelines that enable trusted reporting, advanced analytics, and machine learning.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys designing well‑structured data warehouses, takes pride in clean modelling, and understands that strong analytical outcomes start with solid data foundations.
What You’ll Be Doing
Design, build, and maintain enterprise‑grade data warehouses to support analytics and data science
Apply Kimball dimensional modelling techniques (facts, dimensions, star schemas) to create intuitive and performant datasets
Build and operate scalable ETL / ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and curate data from multiple sources
Develop and optimise Amazon Redshift data warehouse solutions within AWS
Partner closely with Data Analysts to ensure data models support reporting and self‑service analytics
Work with Data Scientists to ensure warehouse structures support advanced analytics and ML use cases
Write high‑quality, maintainable Python and SQL code for transformations and pipeline logic
Ensure data quality, consistency, documentation, and lineage across the warehouse
Own performance tuning, optimisation, and ongoing evolution of warehouse structures
What We’re Looking For
Core Skills & Experience
Strong experience with data warehousing concepts and best practices
Hands‑on experience designing and implementing Kimball‑style dimensional models
Strong SQL skills for analytical querying and transformations
Solid experience with Python for data engineering and orchestration
Proven experience building and maintaining ETL pipelines
Experience working with AWS, particularly Amazon Redshift
Strong understanding of how data warehouses support analytics and data science workloads
Nice to Have
Experience with SAS (or a willingness to learn it)
Exposure to modern analytics engineering or semantic modelling approaches
Experience supporting BI tools and self‑service analytics platforms
Familiarity with data quality checks, testing frameworks, or orchestration tools
How You’ll Work
You’ll be embedded in a cross‑functional data squad with a Data Scientist and Data Analyst
You’ll help shape how data is modelled, stored, and consumed across the organisation
You’ll take ownership of data warehouse layers from raw ingestion through to curated analytics models
You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders to translate analytical needs into robust warehouse designs
Why This Role
Play a key role in shaping and evolving a modern data warehouse platform
Work in genuinely collaborative data teams, not siloed functions
Build data foundations that directly power analytics and data science
Combine strong modelling fundamentals with modern cloud technology
Real opportunity to influence standards, patterns, and long‑term architecture

descriptions.title: Senior CS Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
About us:
Luno is the crypto investment app you can rely on, enabling you to buy, store and explore crypto securely. We’re committed to putting the power of cryptocurrency in everyone's hands sensibly and responsibly.
Since 2013, we’ve helped millions of people around the world invest safely in crypto. We do this by cutting through the hype and supporting customers at every step of the way. All products and cryptocurrencies on our platform must first meet stringent legal, risk and technical security standards.
Transparency is key for us. Luno stores all crypto on a 1:1 basis and we have rigorous processes in place so you can be confident your investment is secure. We’re available in more than 40 countries around the world and we work closely with respective regulators in all of these markets to be fully compliant, as we believe this is the best way to help everyone, everywhere, invest safely.
The role in a nutshell:
The Senior Data Analyst will lead the Customer Success data consolidation and reporting initiatives, focusing on driving automation and standardisation. This includes designing and optimising data models, building and maintaining scalable dashboards and reports on Luno’s BI platform, and performing in-depth analysis to translate complex insights into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role also encompasses providing mentorship and championing data literacy across the Customer Success team.
Your mission will be:
Lead the continued evolution of the Customer Success Data Consolidation Project, driving automation, standardisation, and the reduction of manual reporting processes.
Contribute to the design and optimisation of data models and underlying tables supporting the consolidation initiative.
Design, build, and maintain scalable dashboards, reports, and visualisations within Luno’s BI platform.
Perform in-depth analysis of complex datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that inform strategic and operational decisions.
Partner proactively with stakeholders to clarify requirements, prioritise initiatives, and align deliverables with business objectives.
Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date documentation for Customer Success data definitions, processes, and reporting logic.
Provide guidance, quality control, and mentorship to junior team members to uplift overall team capability.
Champion data literacy by promoting best practices, enabling self-service, and driving adoption of reporting tools across Customer Success.
A little about you:
Requirements & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
5–7+ years of experience in data analysis or a similar analytical role.
Strong proficiency in SQL and extensive experience working with relational databases.
Experience with dimensional modelling (preferred).
Solid understanding of statistical concepts and analytical methodologies.
Experience with data visualisation tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or ThoughtSpot.
Advanced Excel skills for complex data manipulation and analysis.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts, data pipelines, and database design principles.
Technical & Analytical Capabilities
Ability to clean, transform, validate, and prepare large datasets for analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Experience designing scalable reporting solutions and supporting data models.
Exceptional attention to detail with a strong commitment to data accuracy and integrity.
Business & Stakeholder Skills
Strong understanding of business processes and supporting systems, with the ability to interpret the data they generate to produce meaningful insights.
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations aligned to organisational goals.
Business acumen to contextualise insights within strategic and operational priorities.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
Confidence presenting complex findings to non-technical audiences.
Professional Attributes
Critical thinker with sound judgement and structured decision-making skills.
Able to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a team.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Committed to continuous learning and staying current with emerging tools, technologies, and best practices in analytics.
This role requires a proactive, delivery-focused individual who can combine technical depth with strategic thinking to elevate the organisation’s use of data.

descriptions.title: Senior Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
Location: South Africa
Department: Product & Engineering
Reports to: Head of Threat Analytics
Join one of the fastest growing cybersecurity innovators protecting organisations worldwide. Our AI driven email security platform is reshaping how businesses defend themselves against constantly evolving threats, and we're looking for a Senior Data Analyst with a passion for impact, accuracy, and automation to help us push detection performance to the next level.
This is a role where your work directly influences product decisions, customer trust, and real world security outcomes. If you're motivated by solving complex problems, collaborating across disciplines, and shaping measurable improvements, you'll thrive here.
Your Responsibilities:
Analyse large datasets of email security telemetry to uncover detection patterns, false positives/negatives, emerging threats, and behavioural anomalies.
Use AI assisted analytics and automation tools to accelerate investigations and model evaluations.
Spot gaps or deterioration in detection rules, logic, and configuration patterns-and recommend concrete improvements.
Produce clear, accessible insights that empower Customer Success teams to demonstrate value and proactively address concerns.
Build intuitive self-service dashboards and automated reporting (Snowflake, Tableau, etc.) to monitor detection efficacy across customer segments.
Prepare structured performance summaries for cross functional retention and product improvement meetings.
Validate engineering changes by comparing pre/post release performance using statistical and behavioural metrics.
Create consistent frameworks for analysing customer submitted examples and supporting repeatable evaluation processes.
Support ML operations workflows, including experiment tracking, metrics stewardship, version control, and model registry management in MLflow.
Your Story:
We'd love to hear from you if you bring:
6+ years of handson experience in data analysis, ideally within cyber security, detection data, or threat telemetry environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts, with hands-on experience in SQL and Python.
Experience working with detection data, threat telemetry, or security focused datasets.
A talent for interpreting complex issues and communicating them clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Understanding of key email security concepts (SMTP, SPF, DKIM, header analysis, message flows).

descriptions.title: Group HR Data Analyst
descriptions.description:
Company Description
Unifrutti Group is a global leader in premium fresh fruit, managing a fully integrated supply chain from farm to retailer. With 76 years of expertise and a presence in over 50 countries, the company is committed to becoming the world's leading and most sustainable multi-fruit provider. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi and supported by ADQ, Unifrutti cultivates more than 300 fruit varieties across 20,000 hectares in Latin America, Asia, Europe, and Africa. The company operates over 50 processing and cold storage facilities and employs over 17,000 professionals to deliver high-quality produce to 1,000+ customers worldwide. Learn more at www.unifruttigroup.com and explore their official YouTube channel at YouTube.
Introduction
The Group HR Analyst is responsible for managing and maintaining the integrity of Unifrutti’s global workforce data, ensuring accurate, reliable and timely analytics that support strategic decision‑making across the Group.
Reporting to the Group Head of Workforce Analytics, the role owns the collection, cleansing, validation and processing of all people-related data and plays a key role in producing workforce reporting, dashboards and insights for HR, Finance and senior leadership.
The role provides analytical support for workforce planning, organisational insights, headcount reporting, compensation analytics, turnover trends and other workforce metrics.
The Group HR Analyst partners closely with Country HR teams, HR Business Partners, Finance and external providers to ensure consistent data standards, alignment with the single source of truth, and adherence to data governance requirements.
This role is essential to strengthening Unifrutti’s analytics capability and building a data‑driven HR function.
High-Level Summary of the Role
• Own data collection, cleansing, validation and processing for Group workforce datasets.
• Produce and deliver accurate monthly, quarterly and annual HR reports and dashboards.
• Support global workforce planning, forecasting and insight generation.
• Maintain data governance, standards and master data across HR systems.
• Collaborate with Country HR, HRBPs and Finance to ensure aligned, reliable data.
• Identify process improvements and drive efficiencies in reporting and analytics.
Functional Responsibilities
1.      Data Analytics & Reporting
·   Collect, clean, validate and analyse HR data from global HR systems and country submissions.
·   Produce monthly, quarterly and annual workforce reports covering headcount, turnover, demographics, movements, vacancies, overtime and other key metrics.
·   Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards and visualisations using Power BI or similar tools.
·   Ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability of all people data reported to Group leadership.
·   Support ad‑hoc data requests, executive presentations and analysis for HR leadership.
2.    Workforce Planning & Insights
·   Support global workforce planning cycles, modelling and forecasting.
·   Analyse workforce trends including turnover, hiring patterns, absenteeism, demographics, diversity, performance and compensation.
·   Identify risks and opportunities in workforce supply, capacity and capabilities.
·   Provide insights that support organisational planning, restructuring or talent decisions.
·   Support scenario modelling and workforce cost analysis in partnership with Finance.
3. HR Systems, Master Data & Data Governance
Maintain strong data governance, adhering to Group standards, controls and validation processes.
Review, maintain and update master data across HR systems to ensure accuracy and consistency.
Partner with IT, Payroll and external system providers to troubleshoot data issues and ensure alignment.
Support system integration activities relating to workforce data.
Ensure compliance with data privacy, information governance and security requirements.
4. Stakeholder Collaboration & Support
Work closely with Country HR teams to ensure accurate and timely submission of data.
Partner with HR Business Partners and Finance to provide analytical support and problem-solving assistance.
Support Country HR capability building on data accuracy, reporting processes and definitions.
Provide clear communication, guidance and documentation to stakeholders on reporting standards and deadlines.
5. Reporting Efficiency & Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to automate, streamline or standardise reporting processes.
Improve the accuracy, timeliness and usability of workforce dashboards and reports.
Recommend enhancements to data structures, definitions or workflows.
Contribute to the development of a single source of truth for workforce data.
Support implementation of new tools, dashboards or analytic methodologies.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business or a related field.
Advanced level of English (written and verbal).
Additional training in analytics, HR systems or BI tools is advantageous.
Knowledge & Experience
Minimum 3 years of experience in HR analytics, workforce planning or data analysis roles.
Experience supporting multinational or multi-country organisations.
Proven ability to manage large datasets and complex data flows.
Strong proficiency in MS Excel (Advanced level required).
Solid working knowledge of Power BI and experience with HRIS/HCM platforms.
Understanding of HR data structures, metrics, definitions and reporting conventions.
Experience supporting HR governance, reporting cycles and dashboard creation.
Strong stakeholder management experience, including interaction with senior leaders.

descriptions.title: Machine Learning Developer (Freelance)
descriptions.description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.
What We Do
The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.
About The Role
GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Machine Learning expert, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.
Although every project is unique, you might typically:
Design original computational STEM problems that simulate real scientific workflows
Create problems that require Python programming to solve
Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks)
Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains and creative problem-solving approaches
Verify solutions using Python with standard libraries (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
Document problem statements clearly and provide verified correct answers
How To Get Started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.
Requirements
You hold a Master's or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a similar STEM field
You have at least 5 years of Machine Learning experience with proven business impact
Strong programming skills in Python (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn)
Solid understanding of numerical methods and computational algorithms
Research or industry experience involving computational problem-solving
Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines
Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge
Benefits
Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?
Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $32/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio
Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise
Show more

descriptions.description:
Recruiter:
HR Genie
Job Ref:
AM/ETL/10/03/2026
Date posted:
Tuesday, March 10, 2026
Location:
Johannesburg, South Africa
Salary:
Market related
SUMMARY:
ETL/ELT Developer-JHB-OnSite-12 Month Contract
POSITION INFO:
ETL/ELT Developer
Location
Gauteng, Johannesburg
Job Type
Contract – Full-Time hours
Primary Industry
Banking and Finance
Job Description
The ETL/ELT Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining efficient Extract, Transform and Load (ETL) or Extract, Load and Transform (ELT) processes to support data integration and data warehousing needs within the banking and finance sector. This role involves working closely with business analysts, data architects, and other technical teams to ensure data quality, integrity and availability for reporting and analytics purposes. The postholder ensures that data movement processes adhere to organisational standards and regulatory requirements.
Job Duties
Build mappings, transforms and loads
Develop, test, and implement ETL/ELT workflows to extract data from multiple source systems and transform it according to business requirements.
Maintain and optimise existing ETL/ELT processes to improve performance and reliability.
Collaborate with data architects and analysts to design data models and ensure accurate data mapping and integration.
Ensure data quality by performing validation, reconciliation, and error handling during data processing.
Monitor ETL/ELT jobs and troubleshoot issues promptly to minimise downtime.
Document ETL/ELT processes, standards, and best practises for reference and compliance purposes.
Support data governance initiatives by adhering to data security and privacy policies.
Participate in code reviews, testing phases, and deployment activities to ensure robust delivery.
Stay up to date with developments in ETL/ELT tools and industry best practises, recommending improvements where appropriate.
Required Qualifications
Informatica/Datastage.dbt/Matillion., SQL
Strong experience in ETL/ELT development within a banking or financial services environment.
Proficiency in ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services or similar.
Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL, including optimisation techniques.
Experience with data warehousing concepts and dimensional modelling.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Ability to write clear and maintainable technical documentation.
Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Shell scripting or similar is advantageous.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
Education
A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related discipline is preferred.
Relevant professional certifications in ETL tools or data management are advantageous.
Experience
A minimum of three to five years’ experience in ETL/ELT development within a complex data environment.
Proven track record of delivering ETL/ELT solutions in the banking and finance sector is highly desirable.
Experience working on contract assignments or within fast-paced project teams is beneficial.
Knowledge and Skills
Comprehensive knowledge of data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
